methods.title: A Multi-scale CNN for Affordance Segmentation in RGB Images

insight_zh.brief: 早期 RGB scene affordance segmentation
insight_zh.route: 多尺度 CNN 结合 depth、surface normal 与 surface category 等中层线索预测 dense affordance map
insight_zh.insight: scene affordance 可由几何/布局中层表示支撑，不局限于物体类别

methods.insight_en: Fuses depth, normals, and surface cues in a multi-scale CNN to predict scene affordance maps, grounding affordance in mid-level geometry rather than object category.

methods.title: Detecting Object Affordances with Convolutional Neural Networks

insight_zh.brief: 面向机器人抓取的 RGB-D object affordance detection
insight_zh.route: 将 RGB、depth/HHA 等多模态输入 CNN，预测 affordance map 并接机器人抓取 demo
insight_zh.insight: 深度特征能替代手工几何特征，直接服务 real-world grasping

methods.insight_en: Feeds RGB and HHA depth encodings into a CNN to detect pixel-level object affordances, showing learned deep features replace handcrafted geometry for real grasping.

methods.title: Weakly Supervised Affordance Detection

insight_zh.brief: 早期弱监督 affordance detection
insight_zh.route: 用图像级/弱标签学习物体功能区域
insight_zh.insight: affordance 可从不完整标注中学习，但泛化依赖类别和外观先验

methods.insight_en: Learns object affordance regions from weak image-level and keypoint labels, showing affordances are learnable from incomplete annotation but lean on category priors.

methods.title: Object-Based Affordances Detection with Convolutional Neural Networks and Dense Conditional Random Fields

insight_zh.brief: 真实场景 object affordance detection
insight_zh.route: 先检测 object bounding boxes，再用 CNN 预测 affordance feature maps，并用 dense CRF 细化边界
insight_zh.insight: object localization + affordance refinement 比整图直接分割更适合复杂真实场景

methods.insight_en: Couples object detection with CNN affordance prediction and dense-CRF boundary refinement, showing localize-then-refine outperforms whole-image segmentation in clutter.

methods.title: Adaptive Binarization for Weakly Supervised Affordance Segmentation

insight_zh.brief: 弱监督 affordance segmentation 的自适应二值化方法
insight_zh.route: 从 sparse keypoints 迭代训练 CNN，并用近似交叉验证估计二值化阈值参数
insight_zh.insight: 弱监督 affordance 学习中，如何把 soft prediction 变成 mask 本身就是关键步骤

methods.insight_en: Trains affordance segmentation from sparse keypoints with adaptive threshold estimation, showing converting soft predictions into masks is a core weak-supervision step.

methods.title: Learning to Segment Affordances

insight_zh.brief: 将 affordance 当作 dense segmentation
insight_zh.route: 利用 object/part 标注生成 affordance supervision，并用 CNN refinement
insight_zh.insight: part structure 可作为 affordance mask 的中间监督

methods.insight_en: Derives dense scene affordance labels from object and part annotations and refines them with a CNN, showing part structure serves as effective intermediate supervision.

methods.title: Affordance Detection for Task-Specific Grasping Using Deep Learning

insight_zh.brief: 面向 task-specific grasping 的 object affordance detection
insight_zh.route: CNN 预测 affordance、object class 与 orientation，再将 affordance map/region 作为下游 grasp constraint
insight_zh.insight: 核心贡献是 closed-set affordance perception；抓取规划更多是视觉预测的应用验证

methods.insight_en: Predicts affordance maps jointly with object class and orientation, then uses them as task-specific grasp constraints, making manipulation a validation of perception.

methods.title: AffordanceNet: An End-to-End Deep Learning Approach for Object Affordance Detection

insight_zh.brief: ICRA 2018 经典基线
insight_zh.route: object detection + instance-level affordance mask
insight_zh.insight: affordance detection 可纳入 Mask R-CNN 式多任务实例分割框架

methods.insight_en: Extends Mask R-CNN-style instance segmentation with an affordance branch, establishing end-to-end detection plus instance-level affordance masks as a standard baseline.

methods.title: Demo2Vec: Reasoning Object Affordances from Online Videos

insight_zh.brief: 从在线 product review videos 学 object affordance
insight_zh.route: Demo2Vec 将 demonstration video 编码成 embedding，再在目标物体图像上预测 interaction region 和 action label
insight_zh.insight: 互联网 demonstration video 可作为低成本的 V2I affordance source

methods.insight_en: Encodes demonstration videos into embeddings that ground interaction regions and actions on object images, showing online videos supply cheap affordance supervision.

methods.title: Towards Affordance Detection for Robot Manipulation Using Affordance for Parts and Parts for Affordance

insight_zh.brief: part segmentation 与 affordance detection 双向促进
insight_zh.route: 通过底层 part features 推断功能
insight_zh.insight: 几何/部件结构对 affordance 的解释性强

methods.insight_en: Couples part segmentation and affordance detection so each supervises the other, showing geometric part structure strongly explains object function.

methods.title: Context-Based Affordance Segmentation from 2D Images for Robot Actions

insight_zh.brief: 用 object part/context 关系预测 2D affordance segmentation，并在机器人动作中验证
insight_zh.route: 融合 object、part 与 scene context cues 训练 affordance segmentation model，并用机器人动作验证
insight_zh.insight: 上下文和 part relation 比单纯 object category 更接近 action possibility

methods.insight_en: Fuses object, part, and scene-context cues for 2D affordance segmentation, showing contextual part relations track action possibility better than object category alone.

methods.title: Recognizing Object Affordances to Support Scene Reasoning for Manipulation Tasks

insight_zh.brief: category-agnostic region proposal + affordance recognition
insight_zh.route: 用于 manipulation scene reasoning
insight_zh.insight: 从类别先验转向区域级功能识别，有助于 novel object

methods.insight_en: Pairs category-agnostic region proposals with affordance recognition, shifting manipulation reasoning from category priors to region-level function on novel objects.

methods.title: Grounded Human-Object Interaction Hotspots From Video

insight_zh.brief: 从未标注交互视频中学习 object interaction hotspots
insight_zh.route: 训练视频 action classifier 与 anticipation module，在静态目标图像上 hallucinate active interaction features 并用 activation mapping 输出 hotspot heatmap
insight_zh.insight: 真实人类交互视频可作为弱监督 affordance source，能在 novel object 上预测可操作区域

methods.insight_en: Learns interaction hotspots from unlabeled videos by hallucinating active features on static images, turning human demonstrations into weak affordance supervision.

methods.title: AffordanceLearn: Learning Affordance Segmentation for Real-world Robotic Manipulation via Synthetic Images

insight_zh.brief: 用合成图像学习 object affordance segmentation，并迁移到真实视觉输入
insight_zh.route: 在仿真中自动生成像素级 affordance labels，训练 segmentation network，再做 sim-to-real 验证
insight_zh.insight: 论文重心是可扩展视觉监督和 segmentation 泛化，机器人 manipulation 是下游验证

methods.insight_en: Generates pixel-level affordance labels in simulation and trains segmentation networks that transfer sim-to-real, showing simulation supplies scalable dense supervision.

methods.title: A Deep Learning Approach to Object Affordance Segmentation

insight_zh.brief: 利用 human-object interaction 的时空线索做 affordance segmentation
insight_zh.route: 从 HOI/交互线索构造监督，训练 CNN segmentation network 预测 object affordance mask
insight_zh.insight: 交互动态比静态外观更能暴露可用区域

methods.insight_en: Mines spatio-temporal cues from human-object interaction videos to supervise affordance segmentation, showing dynamics reveal usable regions static appearance misses.

methods.title: Ego-Topo: Environment Affordances from Egocentric Video

insight_zh.brief: 从 long-form egocentric video 学习 environment affordance
insight_zh.route: 将第一人称视频组织成 activity-centric zones 和 topological affordance graph，并在不同环境之间链接功能相似的 zones
insight_zh.insight: affordance 可以属于环境中的功能区域，而不只是物体局部；egocentric interaction history 能揭示空间如何被使用

methods.insight_en: Organizes egocentric video into activity-centric zones linked in a topological graph, showing affordances attach to functional environment zones, not single objects.

methods.title: Forecasting Human-Object Interaction: Joint Prediction of Motor Attention and Actions in First Person Video

insight_zh.brief: 第一人称视频中的未来 hand-object interaction forecasting
insight_zh.route: 联合预测 hand motion、interaction hotspots/motor attention 与 future action
insight_zh.insight: 未来接触热点是 affordance 的时序预测形式，比单纯 action label 更接近可交互区域

methods.insight_en: Jointly forecasts hand motion, motor attention, and future actions in first-person video, framing future contact hotspots as a temporal form of affordance prediction.

methods.title: Learning Affordance Landscapes for Interaction Exploration in 3D Environments

insight_zh.brief: 3D environment 中的 affordance landscape discovery
insight_zh.route: RL agent 通过交互探索获得 reward，同时训练 image-based affordance segmentation model 来密化探索信号
insight_zh.insight: 场景 affordance 可通过主动交互自监督发现，并反过来提升 exploration efficiency

methods.insight_en: Trains an RL agent to explore 3D scenes for interaction rewards while distilling an affordance segmenter, showing active interaction self-supervises scene affordance.

methods.title: Object Affordance Detection with Relationship-Aware Network

insight_zh.brief: 面向像素级 object affordance detection 的关系建模网络
insight_zh.route: 同时建模 affordance-affordance 共现关系和 object-affordance 组合关系，输出 dense affordance labels
insight_zh.insight: 同一物体上的多个 affordance 并非独立预测，功能共现结构能改善分割一致性

methods.insight_en: Models affordance co-occurrence and object-affordance relations for dense labeling, showing functional co-occurrence structure improves segmentation consistency.

methods.title: An Affordance Keypoint Detection Network for Robot Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 预测 affordance mask 与操作关键点的视觉模型
insight_zh.route: AffKp 共享视觉 backbone，同时输出 affordance segmentation 和 interaction keypoints/方向/范围等操作几何 cues
insight_zh.insight: 核心贡献是把 affordance 从区域扩展为 keypoint/action geometry 表示，机器人 manipulation 是下游验证

methods.insight_en: Shares one visual backbone to output affordance masks plus interaction keypoints with direction and extent, extending affordance from regions to actionable operation geometry.

methods.title: Manipulation-Oriented Object Perception in Clutter through Affordance Coordinate Frames

insight_zh.brief: 面向 clutter manipulation 的 affordance coordinate frame perception
insight_zh.route: 从 cluttered scene 中检测 object part，并预测与功能部件绑定的 category-level affordance coordinate frames
insight_zh.insight: affordance coordinate frame 将功能部件和 3D pose 统一为 perception output，可作为下游 manipulation interface

methods.insight_en: Detects object parts in clutter and predicts category-level affordance coordinate frames, unifying functional parts and 3D pose into one manipulation-ready output.

methods.title: 3D AffordanceNet: A Benchmark for Visual Object Affordance Understanding

insight_zh.brief: 大规模 3D object affordance benchmark
insight_zh.route: 点云级功能区域预测
insight_zh.insight: affordance grounding 需要从 2D mask 走向具有物理几何意义的 3D surface

methods.insight_en: Benchmarks dense affordance prediction on object point clouds, moving affordance grounding from 2D masks onto physically meaningful 3D surfaces.

methods.title: O2O-Afford: Annotation-Free Large-Scale Object-Object Affordance Learning

insight_zh.brief: 面向 object-object interaction 的 annotation-free large-scale affordance learning
insight_zh.route: 在物理仿真中构造 object-object interaction tasks，用 object-kernel point convolution 建模两个物体之间的细粒度交互区域
insight_zh.insight: 3D affordance 不只可以定义在单个物体表面，也可以由两个物体之间的功能关系决定

methods.insight_en: Simulates object-object interactions and uses object-kernel point convolution to learn fine-grained cross-object affordance maps without human annotation.

methods.title: Visual Affordance Detection Using an Efficient Attention Convolutional Neural Network

insight_zh.brief: 高效 attention CNN 做 pixel-wise affordance detection
insight_zh.route: encoder-decoder 架构中加入 dilated residual backbone、attention module 和上采样层，在 UMD 上预测 affordance mask
insight_zh.insight: 轻量 attention 可补足深层 CNN 对远距离/多尺度功能关系的建模

methods.insight_en: Embeds lightweight attention and dilated residual features in an encoder-decoder, capturing long-range multi-scale functional relations for pixel-wise affordance masks.

methods.title: One-Shot Affordance Detection

insight_zh.brief: AGD20K 早期 one-shot setting
insight_zh.route: 从少量 exemplars 泛化到新物体的 affordance grounding
insight_zh.insight: affordance 可以通过 human interaction exemplar 跨类别迁移

methods.insight_en: Transfers affordance from a single human-interaction exemplar to novel objects, showing affordance generalizes across categories from one support image.

methods.title: PartAfford: Part-level Affordance Discovery from 3D Objects

insight_zh.brief: 从 3D object 中做 part-level affordance discovery
insight_zh.route: 仅用 object-level affordance set supervision，结合 slot attention、part reconstruction、affordance prediction 和 cuboidal primitive regularization，发现 3D part 与 affordance category 的对应关系
insight_zh.insight: 3D affordance 可在缺少 dense point/mask 标注时通过几何 part abstraction 和稀疏 affordance set supervision 学到

methods.insight_en: Discovers 3D part-affordance correspondences from object-level affordance sets alone, combining slot attention with cuboidal primitive regularization.

methods.title: Joint Hand Motion and Interaction Hotspots Prediction from Egocentric Videos

insight_zh.brief: egocentric video 中联合预测手部轨迹和 interaction hotspots
insight_zh.route: 自动生成 trajectory/hotspot labels，并用 Object-Centric Transformer 进行概率预测
insight_zh.insight: affordance hotspot 与 hand trajectory 联合建模能更好刻画未来交互

methods.insight_en: Predicts future hand trajectories and interaction hotspots jointly from egocentric video with an object-centric transformer, letting the two cues reinforce each other.

methods.title: Learning Affordance Grounding from Exocentric Images

insight_zh.brief: AGD20K
insight_zh.route: 从人-物交互图像学习目标物体 affordance heatmap
insight_zh.insight: exocentric human behavior 是低成本 affordance supervision

methods.insight_en: Learns object affordance heatmaps from exocentric human-object interaction images, establishing AGD20K and human behavior as low-cost affordance supervision.

methods.title: One-Shot Transfer of Affordance Regions? AffCorrs!

insight_zh.brief: 用视觉 correspondence 在 exemplar 与 target 之间转移 affordance region
insight_zh.route: 利用 foundation visual features 建立 exemplar-target dense correspondence，并将 source affordance mask 迁移到 target
insight_zh.insight: affordance 迁移可转化为 dense correspondence，而不一定需要类别级训练

methods.insight_en: Transfers affordance masks from one annotated exemplar via dense correspondences built on foundation visual features, requiring no category-level training.

methods.title: Object Affordance Detection with Boundary-Preserving Network for Robotic Manipulation Tasks

insight_zh.brief: 面向机器人操作的边界保持 affordance detection
insight_zh.route: 在 affordance segmentation 中显式保留 object/part boundary，并结合类别-功能关系提升 mask 质量
insight_zh.insight: 功能区域往往贴合物体部件边界，边界监督能减少可操作区域外溢

methods.insight_en: Preserves object and part boundaries during affordance segmentation, showing boundary supervision keeps actionable regions from bleeding past part edges.

methods.title: One-Shot Object Affordance Detection in the Wild

insight_zh.brief: 复杂自然场景中的 one-shot affordance detection
insight_zh.route: OSAD-Net 从 support image 估计 action purpose，并迁移到 candidate images 检测同 affordance object regions
insight_zh.insight: support-example based affordance transfer 比固定类别监督更适合开放环境

methods.insight_en: Estimates action purpose from a support image and transfers it to detect matching affordance regions across cluttered natural scenes beyond fixed category supervision.

methods.title: Fine-Grained Affordance Annotation for Egocentric Hand-Object Interaction Videos

insight_zh.brief: 面向 egocentric HOI video 的细粒度 affordance annotation
insight_zh.route: 用 motor action + grasp type 定义 affordance，并给 EPIC-KITCHENS 添加 affordance/mechanical action 标注
insight_zh.insight: 细粒度 hand-object affordance 需要区分 object functionality、goal action 与 human motor capacity

methods.insight_en: Defines affordance through motor actions and grasp types, adding fine-grained hand-object labels to EPIC-KITCHENS that separate functionality, goal action, and motor capacity.

methods.title: STRAP: Structured Object Affordance Segmentation with Point Supervision

insight_zh.brief: point-supervised object affordance segmentation
insight_zh.route: 建模 label affinity 与 spatial affinity，用 Transformer backbone 和 regularization 从点标注生成 dense masks
insight_zh.insight: affordance 的多标签共现结构可补偿稀疏点监督的不足

methods.insight_en: Recovers dense affordance masks from sparse point labels by modeling label and spatial affinities, exploiting multi-label co-occurrence structure in a transformer.

methods.title: Bayesian Deep Learning for Affordance Segmentation in Images

insight_zh.brief: 概率化 affordance instance segmentation
insight_zh.route: 在 Mask R-CNN 中引入 Monte Carlo dropout，估计 aleatoric/epistemic uncertainty，并提出 mask-level quality metric
insight_zh.insight: affordance segmentation 的不确定性有助于分析边界噪声和视觉困难区域

methods.insight_en: Adds Monte Carlo dropout to Mask R-CNN to estimate aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty, exposing boundary noise and visually hard regions in affordance segmentation.

methods.title: Affordance Grounding From Demonstration Video To Target Image

insight_zh.brief: Video-to-image affordance grounding
insight_zh.route: 从 demonstration video 中提取交互线索，再预测 target image heatmap
insight_zh.insight: demo video 提供了 action-conditioned grounding source

methods.insight_en: Extracts interaction cues from a demonstration video to ground action-conditioned affordance heatmaps on a target image of the same object class.

methods.title: Leverage Interactive Affinity for Affordance Learning

insight_zh.brief: 从 human-object contact 中学习 interactive affinity
insight_zh.route: 利用 human pose/keypoint heuristic perception 从 HOI images 提取 body-part-to-object contact affinity 并迁移到 non-interactive objects
insight_zh.insight: 身体部位和物体局部区域的接触关系能减少 affordance label 的歧义

methods.insight_en: Extracts body-part-to-object contact affinities from HOI images via pose heuristics, reducing label ambiguity when transferring affordance to non-interactive objects.

methods.title: LOCATE: Localize and Transfer Object Parts for Weakly Supervised Affordance Grounding

insight_zh.brief: 弱监督 part-level affordance grounding
insight_zh.route: 结合 exocentric/egocentric 分支与 object-part prototype
insight_zh.insight: part priors 能缓解 weak supervision 下的区域漂移

methods.insight_en: Localizes and transfers object-part prototypes between exocentric and egocentric views, using part priors to curb region drift under weak supervision.

methods.title: Open-Vocabulary Affordance Detection using Knowledge Distillation and Text-Point Correlation

insight_zh.brief: 3D knowledge distillation + text-point correlation
insight_zh.route: 支持 unseen labels/objects
insight_zh.insight: 3D backbone 的几何鲁棒性和文本语义要同时建模

methods.insight_en: Distills open-vocabulary knowledge into a 3D point cloud backbone and correlates text with points, handling unseen affordance labels while keeping geometric robustness.

methods.title: Where2Explore: Few-shot Affordance Learning for Unseen Novel Categories of Articulated Objects

insight_zh.brief: 利用跨类别局部几何相似性选择少量交互进行 exploration
insight_zh.route: 基于局部几何相似性选择 informative interaction trials，再更新 actionability model
insight_zh.insight: 高效探索应优先探索与训练类别不同但功能相关的局部几何

methods.insight_en: Selects informative interaction trials on cross-category similar local geometry, adapting actionability models to unseen articulated categories from few interactions.

methods.title: A Large Scale Multi-View RGBD Visual Affordance Learning Dataset

insight_zh.brief: 多视角 RGB-D visual affordance benchmark
insight_zh.route: 收集 37 类物体、47K RGB-D images，并标注 15 类 affordance 用于 segmentation/recognition benchmark
insight_zh.insight: 多视角 RGB-D 数据能暴露 2D 外观之外的几何 affordance bias

methods.insight_en: Provides 47K multi-view RGB-D images across 37 object categories with 15 affordance labels, exposing geometric affordance biases beyond single-view 2D appearance.

methods.title: Hierarchical Transformer for Visual Affordance Understanding using a Large-scale Dataset

insight_zh.brief: 提出 Visual Affordance Transformer (VAT) 做多视角 RGB-D object affordance segmentation
insight_zh.route: 利用 hierarchical ViT architecture 在不同尺度建模物体 affordance，适配不同尺寸物体和多 affordance 区域，并在 large-scale multi-view RGB-D affordance dataset 上评测
insight_zh.insight: 层级 Transformer 能更好建模多尺度 object affordance，为大规模 RGB-D affordance segmentation 提供强基线

methods.insight_en: Applies a hierarchical vision transformer over multiple scales to segment multi-view RGB-D object affordances, handling varied object sizes and multi-region labels.

methods.title: Grounding 3D Object Affordance from 2D Interactions in Images

insight_zh.brief: X-to-3D grounding
insight_zh.route: 从 2D HOI 图像学习 3D point affordance
insight_zh.insight: 2D interaction 可以通过跨模态对齐转化为 3D functional region

methods.insight_en: Aligns 2D human-object interaction images with point clouds to ground 3D object affordance, showing interaction cues transfer across modalities to functional regions.

methods.title: Multi-label Affordance Mapping from Egocentric Vision

insight_zh.brief: 从 egocentric videos 构建 multi-label spatial affordance maps
insight_zh.route: 利用 3D map 对第一人称交互进行像素级定位，构建 EPIC-Aff 并训练 multi-label segmentation models
insight_zh.insight: 同一区域可承载多个 affordance，scene-level affordance 应具备 metric/spatial 表示

methods.insight_en: Builds EPIC-Aff by localizing egocentric interactions in 3D maps, training multi-label segmentation that lets one scene region carry several spatial affordances.

methods.title: Open-vocabulary Affordance Detection in 3D Point Clouds

insight_zh.brief: CLIP/text supervision 对齐 3D point features 和 affordance words
insight_zh.route: 把 CLIP text embedding 与 point features 对齐，通过 text-conditioned decoder 预测 point affordance
insight_zh.insight: open-vocab 3D affordance 需要 text-point alignment

methods.insight_en: Aligns CLIP text embeddings with point-cloud features through a text-conditioned decoder, enabling open-vocabulary affordance detection beyond fixed 3D label sets.

methods.title: Phrase-Based Affordance Detection via Cyclic Bilateral Interaction

insight_zh.brief: phrase-conditioned affordance detection
insight_zh.route: 在视觉区域和 affordance phrase 之间建立 cyclic bilateral interaction，检测满足同一 action purpose 的区域
insight_zh.insight: phrase supervision 能表达更细的 action purpose，但核心仍是开放词汇 perception/grounding

methods.insight_en: Detects scene regions matching an affordance phrase via cyclic bilateral vision-language interaction, letting free-form action purposes select image areas.

methods.title: LEMON: Learning 3D Human-Object Interaction Relation from 2D Images

insight_zh.brief: 联合预测 human contact、object affordance 和 3D spatial relation
insight_zh.route: 从单张 2D 图像推断 3D human-object relation，并联合学习 contact、affordance 与 spatial relation
insight_zh.insight: affordance、人体接触和空间关系应共同建模，而不是孤立预测

methods.insight_en: Jointly infers human contact, object affordance, and 3D spatial relation from one image, arguing these interaction cues should be modeled together, not in isolation.

methods.title: Weakly Supervised Multimodal Affordance Grounding for Egocentric Images

insight_zh.brief: 弱监督 multimodal affordance grounding
insight_zh.route: 从 exocentric HOI images 与 textual action descriptions 提取 affordance knowledge，再用 pixel-text fusion 转移到 egocentric image
insight_zh.insight: 跨视角视觉线索和文本 action cue 互补，可降低像素级监督需求

methods.insight_en: Fuses exocentric interaction cues with textual action descriptions to ground egocentric affordances, cutting the need for pixel-level supervision.

methods.title: Text-driven Affordance Learning from Egocentric Vision

insight_zh.brief: 从 egocentric vision 和 text labels 学 contact/trajectory affordance
insight_zh.route: 通过 TextAFF80K 扩展监督，并预测 2D contact/trajectory affordance
insight_zh.insight: 文本监督可扩展 egocentric affordance 标签，但这里仍以视觉 grounding 为核心

methods.insight_en: Predicts 2D contact points and trajectories from egocentric video using text-driven supervision scaled by TextAFF80K, extending affordance labels without manual masks.

methods.title: Grounded Affordance from Exocentric View

insight_zh.brief: exocentric-to-egocentric affordance grounding 的扩展研究
insight_zh.route: 从 exocentric HOI 提取 affordance-specific features，并通过 cross-view knowledge transfer 预测 egocentric affordance maps
insight_zh.insight: 跨人/跨视角的 interaction bias 是从 HOI 学 affordance 的核心难点

methods.insight_en: Extracts affordance-specific features from exocentric interactions and transfers them across views, tackling person-specific interaction bias in egocentric grounding.

methods.title: One-Shot Open Affordance Learning with Foundation Models

insight_zh.brief: OOAL
insight_zh.route: CLIP/DINOv2 等 foundation features 支持 one-shot open affordance grounding
insight_zh.insight: 基础视觉模型的 semantic + correspondence prior 可降低 affordance 标注需求

methods.insight_en: Leverages semantic and correspondence priors of CLIP and DINOv2 to learn open-vocabulary affordance grounding from a single annotated example per base class.

methods.title: LASO: Language-guided Affordance Segmentation on 3D Object

insight_zh.brief: language-guided 3D object affordance segmentation
insight_zh.route: 用 text encoder 表示 language query，并通过动态 query kernel 作用于 point-cloud features，输出 3D affordance mask
insight_zh.insight: language query 在这里是 segmentation condition，而不是 LLM/MLLM reasoning；核心贡献仍是 text-conditioned 3D affordance grounding

methods.insight_en: Segments 3D object affordance from language queries by generating dynamic kernels from text that convolve point features, conditioning masks on referring expressions.

methods.title: GLANCE: Intermediate Connectors and Geometric Priors for Language-Guided Affordance Segmentation on Unseen Object Categories

insight_zh.brief: 面向 unseen object categories 的 language-guided 3D affordance segmentation
insight_zh.route: 在 language query 和 point-cloud features 之间引入 intermediate connectors，并结合 geometric priors 强化跨类别 affordance mask grounding
insight_zh.insight: 语言条件可以指定功能区域，但 unseen object 上的 3D affordance segmentation 仍需要显式几何先验和中间特征对齐来稳定落点

methods.insight_en: Inserts intermediate connectors between language queries and point features and adds geometric priors, stabilizing affordance masks on unseen object categories.

methods.title: LGAfford-Net: A Local Geometry Aware Affordance Detection Network for 3D Point Clouds

insight_zh.brief: 面向 3D point cloud 的局部几何感知 affordance detection
insight_zh.route: 在点云 affordance detection 中强化 local geometry 和 neighborhood structure cues，预测 object surface 上的 affordance labels
insight_zh.insight: 3D affordance grounding 不只依赖全局 point features，局部表面几何对功能区域定位很关键

methods.insight_en: Encodes local surface geometry and neighborhood structure for point-cloud affordance detection, showing regional cues beat purely global features for localization.

methods.title: SceneFun3D: Fine-Grained Functionality and Affordance Understanding in 3D Scenes

insight_zh.brief: 3D indoor scene functionality/affordance benchmark
insight_zh.route: 标注对象功能、交互区域和动作相关信息
insight_zh.insight: embodied affordance 需要 scene-level 而非只看 isolated object

methods.insight_en: Annotates fine-grained functional elements, interaction regions, and motions in real indoor scans, benchmarking affordance understanding at scene rather than object level.

methods.title: Learning 2D Invariant Affordance Knowledge for 3D Affordance Grounding

insight_zh.brief: MIFAG
insight_zh.route: 从多张 2D interaction images 中提取 invariant affordance dictionary，再融合到 3D point features
insight_zh.insight: 跨图像共同交互模式比单张 HOI 更稳

methods.insight_en: Distills an invariant affordance dictionary from multiple 2D interaction images into point features, making cross-image consensus steadier than single-image HOI cues.

methods.title: Grounding 3D Scene Affordance From Egocentric Interactions

insight_zh.brief: 从 egocentric interactions 推断 3D scene affordance
insight_zh.route: 从 egocentric RGB-D/trajectory 交互中聚合场景点云证据，监督 3D scene affordance grounding
insight_zh.insight: first-person interaction history 可以作为 scene-level affordance supervision

methods.insight_en: Aggregates egocentric interaction evidence onto scene point clouds, using first-person interaction history as supervision for 3D scene affordance grounding.

methods.title: INTRA: Interaction Relationship-aware Weakly Supervised Affordance Grounding

insight_zh.brief: interaction relationship-aware weakly supervised grounding
insight_zh.route: 用 exocentric images 做 contrastive representation learning，并结合 VLM text embeddings 生成 text-conditioned affordance maps
insight_zh.insight: 不依赖 paired ego-exo 数据也能通过交互关系学习可泛化 affordance

methods.insight_en: Learns text-conditioned affordance maps from exocentric images alone via interaction-relation contrastive learning, dropping the need for paired egocentric data.

methods.title: Visual-Geometric Collaborative Guidance for Affordance Learning

insight_zh.brief: visual-geometric guided interactive affinity learning
insight_zh.route: 结合视觉和几何 cues 从 HOI 中挖掘 interactive affinity，并构建更大规模 CAL dataset
insight_zh.insight: 将几何先验加入 human-object affinity 能增强跨环境 affordance 泛化

methods.insight_en: Combines visual and geometric cues to mine interactive affinity from human-object interactions, adding geometric priors that improve cross-environment generalization.

methods.title: 3D Affordance Keypoint Detection for Robotic Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 从 RGB-D 预测 3D affordance keypoints/quadruplets
insight_zh.route: FAKP-Net 联合 affordance segmentation 与 3D keypoint quadruplet，输出执行位置、方向和范围
insight_zh.insight: 核心是 3D keypoint-level affordance perception；机器人操作用于验证预测几何的可执行性

methods.insight_en: Predicts affordance segmentation plus 3D keypoint quadruplets from RGB-D, giving manipulators executable position, direction, and extent for each affordance.

methods.title: GEAL: Generalizable 3D Affordance Learning with Cross-Modal Consistency

insight_zh.brief: 2D-3D consistency + Gaussian rendering
insight_zh.route: 增强 3D affordance 在 novel/corrupted objects 上的鲁棒性
insight_zh.insight: 把 2D foundation semantics 稳定蒸馏到 3D 几何域

methods.insight_en: Distills 2D foundation semantics into 3D via Gaussian-splatting-based cross-modal consistency, keeping affordance predictions robust on novel and corrupted point clouds.

methods.title: MaskPrompt: Open-Vocabulary Affordance Segmentation with Object Shape Mask Prompts

insight_zh.brief: open-vocabulary 2D affordance segmentation
insight_zh.route: 用 object shape mask prompt 增强视觉特征和文本提示
insight_zh.insight: shape mask 是连接 part boundary 与 function word 的强先验

methods.insight_en: Injects object shape mask prompts into visual and text features, showing part boundaries are a strong prior linking geometry to open-vocabulary function words.

methods.title: AffordanceSAM: Segment Anything Once More in Affordance Grounding

insight_zh.brief: SAM/EVF-SAM adaptation + coarse-to-fine training
insight_zh.route: 输出 affordance heatmap
insight_zh.insight: segmentation foundation model 可以通过轻量 affordance adapter 转成 functional-region predictor

methods.insight_en: Adapts SAM/EVF-SAM with a lightweight affordance adapter and coarse-to-fine training, turning a segmentation foundation model into a functional-region predictor.

methods.title: IAAO: Interactive Affordance Learning for Articulated Objects in 3D Environments

insight_zh.brief: 3DGS 构建 object/part-level 语义与 articulation model，通过交互估计 articulated affordance
insight_zh.route: 用交互观测更新 3DGS/articulation state，并重新估计 part-level action affordance
insight_zh.insight: articulated object 的 affordance、part motion 和 3D reconstruction 应联合更新

methods.insight_en: Builds 3DGS-based object and articulation models updated through interaction, jointly refining part motion estimates and affordances of articulated objects.

methods.title: Weakly-Supervised Affordance Grounding Guided by Part-Level Semantic Priors

insight_zh.brief: 利用 part-level semantic priors 生成/修正伪标签
insight_zh.route: 用 VFM/part parser 产生 part-level semantic pseudo labels，再进行弱监督 mask refinement
insight_zh.insight: VFM 的 part prior 能显著降低 AGD20K 类任务的像素标注成本

methods.insight_en: Generates and refines pseudo masks from VFM part-level semantic priors, showing part priors sharply cut pixel-annotation cost for weakly supervised grounding.

methods.title: Affogato: Learning Open-Vocabulary Affordance Grounding with Automated Data Generation at Scale

insight_zh.brief: 150K open-vocab text-to-3D affordance heatmap 数据与模型
insight_zh.route: 自动生成 text-object-affordance 标注，训练 open-vocab text-to-3D heatmap grounding model
insight_zh.insight: 自动化数据生成能把 affordance grounding 扩展到长尾交互描述

methods.insight_en: Automates 150K text-object-affordance annotations to train open-vocabulary text-to-3D heatmap grounding, scaling coverage to long-tail interaction descriptions.

methods.title: UAD: Unsupervised Affordance Distillation for Generalization in Robotic Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 无人工标注蒸馏 task-conditioned visual affordance model
insight_zh.route: 用 LVM/VLM 自动生成 instruction-affordance pseudo labels，在 frozen visual features 上训练轻量 affordance decoder
insight_zh.insight: UAD 的核心是可泛化 affordance perception/grounding，少量 IL policy 是下游验证

methods.insight_en: Distills VLM-generated instruction-affordance pseudo labels into a light decoder on frozen visual features, yielding task-conditioned affordance without human labels.

methods.title: Reasoning Mamba: Hypergraph-Guided Region Relation Calculating for Weakly Supervised Affordance Grounding

insight_zh.brief: Hypergraph + Mamba 建模 region relation
insight_zh.route: 弱监督 2D affordance grounding
insight_zh.insight: affordance 区域往往由局部 part 与全局 region relation 共同决定

methods.insight_en: Models region relations with a hypergraph-guided Mamba for weakly supervised grounding, combining local part cues with global region context from interaction images.

methods.title: DAG: Unleash the Potential of Diffusion Model for Open-Vocabulary 3D Affordance Grounding

insight_zh.brief: 利用 text-to-image diffusion model 中的 affordance knowledge 做 open-vocabulary 3D object affordance grounding
insight_zh.route: 从 HOI image 和 affordance text 中提取 frozen diffusion features，并与 point-cloud features 融合预测 3D affordance mask
insight_zh.insight: diffusion model 的 HOI 生成先验可以作为 interaction-driven 的开放词汇 affordance knowledge source，并被迁移到 3D 几何 grounding

methods.insight_en: Extracts frozen diffusion features from HOI images and affordance text and fuses them with point clouds, turning generative priors into open-vocabulary 3D grounding.

methods.title: One-Shot Affordance Grounding of Deformable Objects in Egocentric Organizing Scenes

insight_zh.brief: OS-AGDO，面向 egocentric organizing scenes 的 deformable object one-shot affordance grounding
insight_zh.route: DefoSEM 增强可变形物体结构语义，OEKFM 用 ORB keypoints/几何约束强化局部特征，并用 instance-conditional prompts 消解 affordance region 歧义
insight_zh.insight: 可变形物体的 one-shot affordance 泛化需要同时处理部件层级不确定性、形变几何和动作提示歧义

methods.insight_en: Grounds one-shot affordances of deformable objects in egocentric organizing scenes via structural semantics, keypoint geometry, and instance-conditional prompts.

methods.title: Resource-Efficient Affordance Grounding with Complementary Depth and Semantic Prompts

insight_zh.brief: BiT-Align，资源高效的 RGB-depth-text affordance grounding
insight_zh.route: Bypass Prompt Module 将 depth 作为辅助 prompt 注入 RGB encoder，Text Feature Guidance 用文本特征选择/增强 image encoder attention heads
insight_zh.insight: 深度和语义提示可作为轻量 prompt 融合到主视觉编码器，在降低参数量的同时提升 functional region localization

methods.insight_en: Injects depth as bypass prompts and text-guided attention-head selection into an RGB encoder, cutting parameters while sharpening functional region localization.

methods.title: Closed-Loop Transfer for Weakly-supervised Affordance Grounding

insight_zh.brief: 闭环地从 exocentric/egocentric 之间迁移并校正 affordance
insight_zh.route: 在 source-target grounding 之间循环生成伪标签，并用反向一致性校正模型
insight_zh.insight: grounding 结果可反过来指导伪监督更新，减少一次性 transfer 的噪声

methods.insight_en: Cycles pseudo labels between exocentric and egocentric grounding with reverse consistency checks, letting predictions correct the noise of single-pass cross-view transfer.

methods.title: Selective Contrastive Learning for Weakly Supervised Affordance Grounding

insight_zh.brief: selective prototypical/pixel contrastive learning
insight_zh.route: 自适应利用 part/object 粒度信息
insight_zh.insight: 弱监督中不同 affordance 需要不同 granularity 的对比约束

methods.insight_en: Applies selective prototypical and pixel contrastive learning that adapts between part and object granularity, matching supervision granularity to each affordance.

methods.title: OVA-Fields: Weakly Supervised Open-Vocabulary Affordance Fields for Robot Operational Part Detection

insight_zh.brief: 弱监督 open-vocabulary affordance field，用于 robot operational part detection
insight_zh.route: 将开放词汇 affordance/operation descriptions 与 3D field/object part representation 对齐，在弱监督下定位可操作部件
insight_zh.insight: robot operational parts 可被建模为连续 affordance field，比固定类别 part label 更适合开放场景和长尾功能查询

methods.insight_en: Aligns open-vocabulary operation descriptions with continuous 3D affordance fields under weak supervision, localizing robot operational parts beyond fixed part labels.

methods.title: Unlocking 3D Affordance Segmentation with 2D Semantic Knowledge

insight_zh.brief: CMAT/CAST
insight_zh.route: 将 2D VFM semantic affinity 迁移到 3D encoder，再做 prompt-aware 3D affordance segmentation
insight_zh.insight: 3D 稀疏噪声可由 2D semantic relation 补足

methods.insight_en: Transfers 2D VFM semantic affinities into a 3D encoder for prompt-aware affordance segmentation, using dense 2D relations to offset sparse, noisy point clouds.

methods.title: Affostruction: 3D Affordance Grounding with Generative Reconstruction

insight_zh.brief: 从 partial RGB-D observation 做 text-query 3D affordance grounding
insight_zh.route: 通过 generative reconstruction 从局部 RGB-D 观测重建完整物体几何，并在 full shape 上定位 affordance，包括未观测表面；同时用预测的 affordance 指导 active view selection
insight_zh.insight: 3D affordance grounding 不应只局限于可见表面，生成式补全可以把功能区域扩展到遮挡或未观测的物体部分

methods.insight_en: Reconstructs full object geometry from partial RGB-D via generative completion, grounding text-queried affordances on occluded surfaces and guiding active view selection.

methods.title: PanoAffordanceNet: Towards Holistic Affordance Grounding in 360° Indoor Environments

insight_zh.brief: 提出 360° indoor environment 中的 holistic affordance grounding，并构建 360-AGD panoramic affordance grounding dataset
insight_zh.route: 用 distortion-aware spectral modulator 处理 ERP 几何畸变，用 omni-spherical densification head 恢复稀疏激活的拓扑连续性，并结合 pixel-wise、distributional、region-text contrastive 约束抑制 semantic drift
insight_zh.insight: embodied scene affordance 不应局限于 perspective view；全景场景需要同时处理球面畸变、跨尺度对齐和全局空间连续性

methods.insight_en: Grounds scene affordances in 360-degree panoramas via distortion-aware spectral modulation and spherical densification, extending grounding beyond perspective views.

methods.title: AffordMatcher: Affordance Learning in 3D Scenes from Visual Signifiers

insight_zh.brief: AffordBridge dataset + cross-modal keypoint matching
insight_zh.route: 从 scene 中的 visual signifiers 定位 affordance
insight_zh.insight: 场景 affordance 可通过 2D signifier 和 3D instance correspondence 学习

methods.insight_en: Matches 2D visual signifiers to 3D scene instances via cross-modal keypoint correspondence on the AffordBridge dataset, learning scene affordances from signifier cues.

methods.title: AFUN: Towards an Affordance Foundation Model for Functionality Understanding

insight_zh.brief: 从单帧 RGB-D 与语言任务预测 task-conditional functional mask 和 3D post-contact motion curve
insight_zh.route: 将 robot、human、simulation 和 real-world scan 数据标准化为 language、mask 与 object-centric 3D motion labels，训练开放世界 affordance foundation model
insight_zh.insight: 功能理解需要同时预测 where-to-interact 与 how-to-interact，但核心贡献仍是可泛化的 affordance grounding/representation，机器人操作只是下游验证

methods.insight_en: Standardizes robot, human, and simulation data into language-mask-motion labels to train a foundation model predicting where and how to interact from one RGB-D frame.

methods.title: Reasoning about Object Affordances in a Knowledge Base Representation

insight_zh.brief: 早期 knowledge-base affordance reasoning
insight_zh.route: 从图像和 metadata 中抽取 object、attribute 与 affordance facts，用 Markov Logic Network 学习 knowledge base，并支持 zero-shot affordance prediction 和 object recognition from human pose 等推理任务
insight_zh.insight: affordance 可以作为知识库中的显式关系进行概率逻辑推断，而不是为每个 affordance 单独训练分类器

methods.insight_en: Encodes object, attribute, and affordance facts in a Markov Logic Network knowledge base, enabling zero-shot affordance inference without per-affordance classifiers.

methods.title: Bootstrapping Relational Affordances of Object Pairs Using Transfer

insight_zh.brief: 面向 object-pair affordance 的关系式推断与迁移学习
insight_zh.route: 从已知物体对的交互/关系 affordance 中学习可迁移的 pairwise relation，并将其推广到新的物体组合
insight_zh.insight: affordance 不只属于单个物体或局部区域，也可以由两个物体之间的功能关系决定；object-pair relation 为后续 object-object affordance reasoning 提供了早期范式

methods.insight_en: Learns transferable pairwise relations from object-pair interactions, showing affordances can be defined by functional relations between objects, not single objects.

methods.title: Learning to Act Properly: Predicting and Explaining Affordances From Images

insight_zh.brief: 从 egocentric scene image 预测并解释 action-object affordance
insight_zh.route: 构建 ADE-Affordance，并用 GNN 在 scene context 中传播对象关系以预测可行/不合适动作
insight_zh.insight: affordance 还受社会规范和场景上下文约束，不只是局部几何属性

methods.insight_en: Builds ADE-Affordance and propagates scene-level object relations with a GNN, showing affordances depend on social norms and context, not just local geometry.

methods.title: Object Affordance Based Multimodal Fusion for Natural Human-Robot Interaction

insight_zh.brief: 用 object affordance 帮机器人理解 spoken-language intent 并抓取目标物体
insight_zh.route: CNN 识别 human-centered object affordance，NLP 模块抽取 spoken intention，再用 multimodal fusion 选择 intended object 并在 PR2 上抓取
insight_zh.insight: 早期 task-oriented affordance reasoning 已把“想喝水”这类隐式意图映射到 affordance/object

methods.insight_en: Fuses CNN-detected object affordances with spoken-intention parsing to select and grasp the intended object, mapping implicit needs like thirst to affordances.

methods.title: Learning Grasp Affordance Reasoning through Semantic Relations

insight_zh.brief: 基于对象语义属性和关系推断 task-specific grasp affordance
insight_zh.route: 用 Markov Logic Networks 建立 attribute-affordance relation graph，再根据当前任务/对象语义推断 prototypical grasp patches
insight_zh.insight: 不是枚举所有可抓区域，而是根据任务与语义关系选择功能性抓取 affordance

methods.insight_en: Uses Markov Logic Networks over attribute-affordance relations to infer task-specific grasp regions, selecting functional grasps instead of enumerating graspable areas.

methods.title: Intention-Related Natural Language Grounding via Object Affordance Detection and Intention Semantic Extraction

insight_zh.brief: 面向意图式自然语言查询的 affordance-based visual grounding
insight_zh.route: attention-based multi-visual feature fusion 检测 object affordance，语义抽取模块解析 intention query，再融合定位目标物体
insight_zh.insight: affordance 可以作为 implicit language intent 与 visual target grounding 之间的语义桥

methods.insight_en: Combines attention-based affordance detection with intention semantic extraction to ground implicit queries, treating affordance as the intent-to-target semantic bridge.

methods.title: Relationship Oriented Affordance Learning through Manipulation Graph Construction

insight_zh.brief: 根据场景中的物体关系推断 manipulation affordance
insight_zh.route: 构建 Manipulation Relationship Graph，用属性与上下文模块预测 object-object action relationship
insight_zh.insight: scene affordance reasoning 的关键是当前环境中物体之间的功能关系，而非单物体属性预测

methods.insight_en: Builds a manipulation relationship graph to predict object-object action relations, grounding scene affordances in inter-object function, not per-object attributes.

methods.title: A Visual Affordance Reasoning Network Based on Graph Attention

insight_zh.brief: 基于 graph attention 的 visual affordance reasoning network
insight_zh.route: 将视觉对象和上下文组织为图结构，并用 graph attention 建模 affordance-relevant relations
insight_zh.insight: 关系式 affordance reasoning 可以由可学习的图注意力实现，从显式 knowledge graph / manipulation graph 扩展到视觉图结构上的关系聚合

methods.insight_en: Organizes objects and context into a visual graph and uses graph attention to aggregate affordance-relevant relations, making relational reasoning learnable.

methods.title: Do As I Can, Not As I Say: Grounding Language in Robotic Affordances

insight_zh.brief: SayCan
insight_zh.route: LLM 给出高层技能序列，value/affordance function 判断当前机器人能否执行
insight_zh.insight: 语言合理性必须与 embodied feasibility 相乘

methods.insight_en: Scores LLM-proposed skills with learned value functions as affordances, multiplying language plausibility by embodied feasibility to select executable robot actions.

methods.title: Grounded Decoding: Guiding Text Generation with Grounded Models for Robot Control

insight_zh.brief: 用 grounded models 在 decoding 时约束 LLM 生成可执行动作
insight_zh.route: 在 LLM decoding 阶段接入视觉/可执行性模型分数，对候选动作 token 进行 grounded re-ranking
insight_zh.insight: affordance/grounding 可以直接进入语言生成过程，而不只是后验过滤

methods.insight_en: Injects grounded model scores into LLM decoding to re-rank action tokens, bringing affordance constraints into generation itself rather than post-hoc filtering.

methods.title: AffordanceLLM: Grounding Affordance from Vision Language Models

insight_zh.brief: 利用 VLM/LLM 的 HOI world knowledge 辅助 2D affordance grounding
insight_zh.route: 用 MLLM 生成 affordance、part、function priors，再与视觉 grounding network 融合预测 heatmap
insight_zh.insight: affordance grounding 需要常识和功能语义，而不只是纹理

methods.insight_en: Fuses MLLM-generated part and function priors with a visual grounding network to predict affordance heatmaps, injecting commonsense semantics beyond texture cues.

methods.title: NaturalVLM: Leveraging Fine-grained Natural Language for Affordance-Guided Visual Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 根据细粒度自然语言和当前操作阶段推断 3D contact/end-effector constraints
insight_zh.route: MLLM 将 long-horizon instruction 分解为可执行 contact point 与 end-effector pose，再交由 planner/policy 执行
insight_zh.insight: 核心是 task-conditioned affordance/action constraint reasoning，机器人执行是下游落地

methods.insight_en: Decomposes long-horizon instructions with an MLLM into contact points and end-effector poses, treating manipulation as task-conditioned affordance constraint reasoning.

methods.title: OVAL-Prompt: Open-Vocabulary Affordance Localization for Robot Manipulation through LLM Affordance-Grounding

insight_zh.brief: open-vocabulary task prompt 下推断可抓/应避 object part 并定位 affordance region
insight_zh.route: LLM 生成 affordance part prompts，VLM/SAM 定位区域，再给 grasp planner 做 downstream execution
insight_zh.insight: 核心是 task-aware part/function reasoning + localization，而非机器人 policy 本身

methods.insight_en: Prompts an LLM for task-relevant part descriptions and localizes them with VLM/SAM, enabling open-vocabulary affordance localization without policy training.

methods.title: WorldAfford: Affordance Grounding based on Natural Language Instructions

insight_zh.brief: 根据自然语言任务指令定位 affordance region
insight_zh.route: 将任务指令解析为 object-part-function query，并用 vision-language grounding 输出 affordance mask
insight_zh.insight: instruction-to-affordance grounding 是 open-set embodied perception 的关键接口

methods.insight_en: Parses instructions into object-part-function queries and grounds them to affordance masks, an open-set interface for embodied perception.

methods.title: Multimodal Attention-Based Instruction-Following Part-Level Affordance Grounding

insight_zh.brief: 根据自然语言操作指令直接分割相关 object part affordance
insight_zh.route: IAG-Net 用句子级和 task-specific 文本特征，与多尺度视觉特征做 multimodal attention fusion，输出 part-level affordance mask
insight_zh.insight: instruction-following manipulation 需要 part-level affordance grounding，而不是只做 object-level grounding

methods.insight_en: Fuses sentence-level and task-specific text features with multiscale visual features via attention to segment part-level affordances, not just object-level regions.

methods.title: RoboPoint: A Vision-Language Model for Spatial Affordance Prediction for Robotics

insight_zh.brief: VLM 预测机器人空间交互点
insight_zh.route: 通过合成/视觉提示数据 instruction tuning
insight_zh.insight: point-level visual prompting 可把高层语言转为可执行空间约束

methods.insight_en: Instruction-tunes a VLM on synthetic visual-prompting data to predict spatial interaction points, converting high-level language into executable spatial constraints.

methods.title: Knowledge Enhanced Bottom-Up Affordance Grounding for Robotic Interaction

insight_zh.brief: 引入外部知识增强 language-conditioned affordance grounding
insight_zh.route: KBAG-Net 将知识增强文本特征与 low/high-level visual features 自底向上融合，并半自动生成 language-following manipulation grounding 数据
insight_zh.insight: commonsense knowledge 对 implicit instruction 到 affordance part 的映射很关键

methods.insight_en: Fuses knowledge-enhanced text features with multilevel visual features bottom-up, showing commonsense is key for mapping implicit instructions to affordance parts.

methods.title: ManipVQA: Injecting Robotic Affordance and Physically Grounded Information into Multi-Modal Large Language Models

insight_zh.brief: 用 VQA 数据向 MLLM 注入 tool/affordance/physical concepts
insight_zh.route: 构造 robotic affordance/physics VQA instruction data，对 MLLM 进行监督微调与评测
insight_zh.insight: 通用 MLLM 缺少 manipulation-specific affordance，需要专门监督

methods.insight_en: Fine-tunes an MLLM on robotic affordance and physics VQA instruction data, showing generic MLLMs need manipulation-specific supervision to ground tool concepts.

methods.title: PAVLM: Advancing Point Cloud based Affordance Understanding Via Vision-Language Model

insight_zh.brief: 将 point cloud affordance understanding 接入 VLM/LLM 语义能力
insight_zh.route: 编码点云为 token/视图特征，与 language query 对齐后进行 affordance QA/segmentation
insight_zh.insight: 3D affordance 的开放语义可由 VLM/LLM 做高层补全

methods.insight_en: Aligns point-cloud tokens with language queries in a VLM for 3D affordance QA and segmentation, using LLM semantics to supply open-vocabulary affordance labels.

methods.title: GREAT: Geometry-Intention Collaborative Inference for Open-Vocabulary 3D Object Affordance Grounding

insight_zh.brief: geometry + interaction intention collaborative inference
insight_zh.route: 用 CoT/analogical reasoning 推断 novel affordance
insight_zh.insight: 开放 affordance 需要“几何像什么”和“交互意图是什么”一起推理

methods.insight_en: Combines geometric analogy with interaction-intention chain-of-thought reasoning, grounding open-vocabulary 3D affordances by inferring both cues jointly on novel objects.

methods.title: SeqAfford: Sequential 3D Affordance Reasoning via Multimodal Large Language Model

insight_zh.brief: 将复杂指令分解为 sequential 3D affordance maps
insight_zh.route: MLLM 分解自然语言任务步骤，并逐步生成或更新 3D affordance map
insight_zh.insight: long-horizon task 中 affordance 是随步骤变化的状态序列

methods.insight_en: Decomposes complex instructions with an MLLM and sequentially generates 3D affordance maps, treating affordance as a step-varying state in long-horizon tasks.

methods.title: 3D-AffordanceLLM: Harnessing Large Language Models for Open-Vocabulary Affordance Detection in 3D Worlds

insight_zh.brief: LLM 生成/理解 affordance query，3D encoder 负责点云 grounding
insight_zh.route: LLM 生成 open-vocab affordance query，3D encoder/decoder 将语义落到 point-level mask
insight_zh.insight: LLM 常识能提升 open-vocab 3D affordance detection

methods.insight_en: Pairs LLM-generated open-vocabulary affordance queries with a 3D encoder-decoder that grounds them to point-level masks, showing LLM commonsense aids 3D detection.

methods.title: Afford-X: Generalizable and Slim Affordance Reasoning for Task-oriented Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 面向 task-oriented manipulation 的轻量化、可泛化 affordance reasoning
insight_zh.route: 构建 LVIS-Aff 数据集，包含大规模任务-图像 affordance reasoning 样本，并提出 187M 参数的 Afford-X，通过 Verb Attention 和 Bi-Fusion 模块融合任务语义与视觉证据
insight_zh.insight: task-oriented affordance reasoning 不一定依赖大型 MLLM；紧凑模型也可以把任务语义、物体功能和视觉 grounding 结合起来，并在机器人操作中作为下游验证

methods.insight_en: Trains a slim 187M-parameter model with verb attention and bi-fusion on the LVIS-Aff dataset, showing task-oriented affordance reasoning does not require a large MLLM.

methods.title: Grounding 3D Object Affordance with Language Instructions, Visual Observations and Interactions

insight_zh.brief: LMAffordance3D
insight_zh.route: 融合 language、2D visual observation、3D geometry 与 interaction
insight_zh.insight: instruction、observation、interaction 三类证据互补

methods.insight_en: Fuses language instructions, 2D observations, 3D geometry, and interaction cues to ground 3D object affordances, exploiting the complementarity of the three evidence types.

methods.title: 3DAffordSplat: Efficient Affordance Reasoning with 3D Gaussians

insight_zh.brief: 基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 的 task-conditioned affordance reasoning
insight_zh.route: 用 3DGS 表示场景/物体，并在可渲染 Gaussian features 上预测 task-conditioned affordance
insight_zh.insight: 3DGS 可作为高效、可渲染的 affordance reasoning 表示

methods.insight_en: Represents objects with 3D Gaussian splatting and predicts task-conditioned affordances on renderable Gaussian features, making 3DGS an efficient reasoning substrate.

methods.title: UniAff: A Unified Representation of Affordances for Tool Usage and Articulation with Vision-Language Models

insight_zh.brief: 统一建模工具使用和 articulated object 操作中的 affordance 与 3D motion constraints
insight_zh.route: 构建覆盖 articulated objects 和 tools 的 manipulation attribute dataset，并利用 VLM/MLLM 推断 object-centric affordance representation、motion type、axis/direction 等约束
insight_zh.insight: tool usage 和 articulation 可以共享统一的 affordance/motion-constraint 表示，使 affordance 从区域识别扩展到可解释的 3D manipulation reasoning

methods.insight_en: Unifies tool-use and articulation affordances with 3D motion constraints, using a VLM to infer motion type and axes for interpretable manipulation reasoning.

methods.title: InstructPart: Task-Oriented Part Segmentation with Instruction Reasoning

insight_zh.brief: 面向 everyday contexts 的 task-oriented part segmentation benchmark
insight_zh.route: 构建带 hand-labeled part segmentation annotations 和 task-oriented instructions 的 InstructPart 数据，并评测/微调 VLM 做 instruction-conditioned part segmentation
insight_zh.insight: 很多 VLM 仍把物体视为不可分割整体，task-level instruction reasoning 需要落到 part-level affordance/function understanding

methods.insight_en: Builds a benchmark of hand-labeled part masks paired with task instructions, revealing VLMs still treat objects as wholes and must ground tasks at the part level.

methods.title: Functionality Understanding and Segmentation in 3D Scenes

insight_zh.brief: Fun3DU，面向 3D scene 的 natural-language functionality understanding 与 segmentation
insight_zh.route: language model 通过 CoT 从任务描述推断目标 functional object，VLM 在多视角图像中分割目标，再用几何信息 lift/aggregate 到 3D point cloud
insight_zh.insight: 3D scene affordance/functionality grounding 需要结合语言常识推理和空间几何对齐，training-free foundation model pipeline 可作为强 baseline

methods.insight_en: Chains LLM reasoning over task descriptions with VLM multi-view segmentation lifted to 3D point clouds, giving a training-free baseline for functionality grounding.

methods.title: Affordance Benchmark for MLLMs

insight_zh.brief: 系统评测 MLLM affordance understanding/grounding
insight_zh.route: 构造 MLLM affordance QA/grounding benchmark，用多维指标评测常识、区域和物理理解
insight_zh.insight: “识别物体”和“判断可交互区域/用途”在 MLLM 中仍有明显差距

methods.insight_en: Benchmarks MLLM affordance QA and grounding across commonsense, regional, and physical axes, exposing a gap between recognizing objects and judging interactions.

methods.title: RAGNet: Large-scale Reasoning-based Affordance Segmentation Benchmark towards General Grasping

insight_zh.brief: 面向 general grasping 的 reasoning-based affordance segmentation benchmark
insight_zh.route: 构建 reasoning-rich grasp affordance 数据，并训练 language/reasoning-conditioned segmentation model
insight_zh.insight: grasp affordance 需要从单标签 mask 走向 reasoning-rich 标注

methods.insight_en: Builds a large-scale reasoning-rich grasp affordance segmentation benchmark and trains language-conditioned models, pushing grasp affordance beyond single-label masks.

methods.title: SeqAffordSplat: Scene-level Sequential Affordance Reasoning on 3D Gaussian Splatting

insight_zh.brief: 在 3DGS scene 中做 sequential affordance reasoning
insight_zh.route: 在 3DGS 场景表示上执行多步 instruction decomposition 和 sequential affordance update
insight_zh.insight: scene-level 3D affordance 可用可渲染 memory 表示进行多步更新

methods.insight_en: Performs multi-step instruction decomposition and sequential affordance updates on 3D Gaussian splatting scenes, using the renderable representation as scene memory.

methods.title: Affordance-R1: Reinforcement Learning for Generalizable Affordance Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Model

insight_zh.brief: GRPO/RL post-training MLLM 做 affordance reasoning
insight_zh.route: reward 包含格式、感知、认知约束
insight_zh.insight: RL 可显著提升 MLLM 的可解释 grounding 推理

methods.insight_en: Applies GRPO reinforcement learning post-training to an MLLM with format, perception, and cognition rewards, markedly improving interpretable affordance grounding.

methods.title: Agentic Scene Policies: Unifying Space, Semantics, and Affordances for Robot Action

insight_zh.brief: ASP，用可查询的 scene representation 组织 language-conditioned robot decision making
insight_zh.route: agentic framework 统一调用语义、空间和 affordance queries，根据查询结果选择目标、约束和 primitive skills，并交由下游 motion planning 执行
insight_zh.insight: 复杂机器人任务的关键不一定是重新学习低层动作，而是把 open-vocabulary 语义、空间可行性和 affordance evidence 组织成可执行的 scene-level decision interface

methods.insight_en: Unifies semantic, spatial, and affordance queries over a queryable scene representation into an agentic interface that selects targets and primitive skills for planning.

methods.title: Open-Vocabulary 3D Affordance Understanding via Functional Text Enhancement and Multilevel Representation Alignment

insight_zh.brief: 面向 text label 与 question 的 open-vocabulary 3D affordance understanding
insight_zh.route: functional text enhancement 生成/增强功能语义描述，并通过 multilevel language-point alignment 支持 affordance label 与 question grounding
insight_zh.insight: 当模型需要理解 question-level functional query 时，affordance grounding 已从 closed-set perception 转向 language reasoning

methods.insight_en: Enhances functional text descriptions and aligns them with point features at multiple levels to ground both labels and questions in open-vocabulary 3D affordance.

methods.title: AffordGrasp: In-Context Affordance Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Task-Oriented Grasping in Clutter

insight_zh.brief: 面向 clutter 中 open-vocabulary task-oriented grasping 的 in-context affordance reasoning
insight_zh.route: 用 VLM 从隐式用户指令中推断 task goal、目标物体和功能部件，再通过 visual grounding 得到 part-level affordance mask，并交给 grasp generator 生成 task-oriented grasp poses
insight_zh.insight: 任务导向抓取的关键不只是生成稳定抓取，而是先从隐式意图中推断应该抓哪个物体、哪个功能部件以及为什么该部件满足任务

methods.insight_en: Infers task goal, target object, and functional part from implicit instructions with a VLM, grounding part-level masks for task-oriented grasping in clutter.

methods.title: AffordBot: 3D Fine-grained Embodied Reasoning via Multimodal Large Language Models

insight_zh.brief: 多视角渲染 + MLLM 推理 3D affordance element 的位置、motion type、axis
insight_zh.route: 多视角渲染 3D object/scene，MLLM CoT 推理后输出 affordance element 与 motion parameters
insight_zh.insight: fine-grained affordance 不止是 mask，还包括操作运动参数

methods.insight_en: Renders 3D scenes into multi-view images for MLLM chain-of-thought reasoning that outputs affordance elements with motion type and axis, going beyond masks.

methods.title: RoboAfford++: A Generative AI-Enhanced Dataset for Multimodal Affordance Learning in Robotic Manipulation and Navigation

insight_zh.brief: 大规模 VQA/QA 数据，覆盖 object affordance、placement、navigation spatial affordance
insight_zh.route: 用生成式 AI 扩展图像/场景 VQA 标注，覆盖 manipulation 与 navigation affordance tasks
insight_zh.insight: MLLM 需要细粒度 affordance QA 数据才能从 scene understanding 走向 actionability

methods.insight_en: Builds a generative-AI-expanded VQA dataset covering object, placement, and navigation affordances, moving MLLMs from scene understanding toward actionability.

methods.title: Task-Aware 3D Affordance Segmentation via 2D Guidance and Geometric Refinement

insight_zh.brief: TASA
insight_zh.route: 自然语言任务驱动 2D affordance detection，再做 3D geometric refinement
insight_zh.insight: 2D semantic cue 负责找目标，3D geometry 负责物理一致性

methods.insight_en: Couples language-driven 2D affordance detection with 3D geometric refinement, letting semantic cues locate targets while geometry enforces physical consistency.

methods.title: A4-Agent: An Agentic Framework for Zero-Shot Affordance Reasoning

insight_zh.brief: training-free agentic affordance reasoning framework，用多模型协作做 zero-shot affordance prediction
insight_zh.route: Dreamer 用生成模型想象交互外观，Thinker 用 VLM 判断应交互的 object part，Spotter 调用视觉 foundation model 精确定位 interaction area
insight_zh.insight: 将 affordance prediction 解耦为 how/what/where 三阶段 agentic pipeline，可提升 novel objects 和 unseen environments 泛化

methods.insight_en: Decomposes zero-shot affordance prediction into a training-free how/what/where pipeline of Dreamer, Thinker, and Spotter agents, improving novel-object generalization.

methods.title: TRACER: Texture-Robust Affordance Chain-of-Thought for Deformable-Object Refinement

insight_zh.brief: 根据 high-level task intention 做 deformable-object affordance CoT 与 functional region refinement
insight_zh.route: Tree-structured Affordance CoT 分解任务语义，SCBR/ICRF 细化边界与连续 functional regions
insight_zh.insight: 核心是从任务语义到物理交互区域的层级 reasoning，机器人长程执行用于验证

methods.insight_en: Decomposes task semantics via tree-structured affordance chain-of-thought and refines boundaries into continuous functional regions on deformable objects.

methods.title: AffordanceGrasp-R1: Leveraging Reasoning-Based Affordance Segmentation with Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Grasping

insight_zh.brief: CoT cold-start + RL 提升 language-conditioned grasp affordance segmentation
insight_zh.route: 用 CoT cold-start 数据初始化 MLLM，再以 RL reward 优化 segmentation/reasoning 输出
insight_zh.insight: grasping 场景中 MLLM spatial grounding 可用 RL 显著校准

methods.insight_en: Cold-starts an MLLM with chain-of-thought data, then optimizes affordance segmentation with RL rewards to calibrate spatial grounding for grasping.

methods.title: VideoAfford: Grounding 3D Affordance from Human-Object-Interaction Videos via Multimodal Large Language Model

insight_zh.brief: VIDA 视频数据 + latent action encoder + MLLM
insight_zh.route: 从 HOI video 到 3D affordance
insight_zh.insight: 动态交互视频提供 causal/temporal affordance evidence

methods.insight_en: Grounds 3D affordance from human-object interaction videos via a latent action encoder and MLLM, exploiting dynamic video as causal and temporal affordance evidence.

methods.title: arg-VU: Affordance Reasoning with Physics-Aware 3D Geometry for Visual Understanding in Robotic Surgery

insight_zh.brief: 3DGS + XPBD/physics-aware compliance energy
insight_zh.route: 用于 surgical affordance
insight_zh.insight: deformable/surgical affordance 必须显式考虑物理可行性

methods.insight_en: Combines 3D Gaussian splatting with XPBD physics-aware compliance energy for surgical affordance reasoning, making deformable feasibility explicit.

methods.title: SceneTeract: Agentic Functional Affordances and VLM Grounding in 3D Scenes

insight_zh.brief: VLM 高层 activity decomposition + 低层 3D reachability/clearance/navigability checks
insight_zh.route: 还能作 reward engine
insight_zh.insight: scene affordance 是 agent-specific physical feasibility

methods.insight_en: Pairs VLM activity decomposition with 3D reachability and clearance checks, casting scene affordance as agent-specific physical feasibility and a reward engine.

methods.title: Part-Aware Open-Vocabulary 3D Affordance Grounding via Prototypical Semantic and Geometric Alignment

insight_zh.brief: LLM 生成 part-aware instruction，结合 semantic/geometric prototypes
insight_zh.route: LLM 生成 part-aware affordance queries，结合 semantic prototype 和 geometric prototype 做 point grounding
insight_zh.insight: open-vocab 3D affordance 需要跨对象 part-level 原型对齐

methods.insight_en: Generates part-aware queries with an LLM and aligns semantic and geometric prototypes for point grounding, enabling cross-object part-level open-vocabulary transfer.

methods.title: A3R: Agentic Affordance Reasoning via Cross-Dimensional Evidence in 3D Gaussian Scenes

insight_zh.brief: MLLM policy 迭代选择 2D/3D evidence acquisition actions，并用 GRPO 优化
insight_zh.route: agent 在 2D views 与 3DGS evidence 间迭代采样/验证，并用 RL 优化 evidence policy
insight_zh.insight: 复杂场景 affordance reasoning 是 sequential evidence acquisition

methods.insight_en: Trains an MLLM policy with GRPO to iteratively acquire 2D view and 3D Gaussian evidence, framing scene affordance reasoning as sequential evidence acquisition.

methods.title: CompassAD: Intent-Driven 3D Affordance Grounding in Functionally Competing Objects

insight_zh.brief: implicit intent 指令下在多物体竞争场景选择正确 object 和 region
insight_zh.route: 根据隐式意图构造 competing-object reasoning，并在 3D point/scene features 中定位目标区域
insight_zh.insight: task intent 不只决定 part，还决定多个可用物体中的正确目标

methods.insight_en: Grounds implicit intent in 3D scenes with functionally competing objects, showing task intent selects both the correct object and its interaction region.

methods.title: Affordance Agent Harness: Verification-Gated Skill Orchestration

insight_zh.brief: 面向 open-world affordance grounding 的闭环 test-time skill orchestration framework
insight_zh.route: 用 Router 自适应选择 detection、segmentation、interaction-imagination 等异构技能，结合 evidence store、episodic memory、cost control 和 affordance-specific Verifier，通过 self-consistency、cross-scale stability 与 evidence sufficiency 进行提交前验证和 targeted retry
insight_zh.insight: 开放场景 affordance grounding 不只是模型预测问题，也需要运行时证据获取、可靠性验证、记忆复用和成本控制；核心贡献是 agentic workflow，而非单一 perception model 或 robot action policy

methods.insight_en: Routes among heterogeneous perception skills with episodic memory and cost control, gating commits through an affordance verifier that triggers targeted retries.

methods.title: Grounding by Remembering: Cross-Scene and In-Scene Memory for 3D Functional Affordances

insight_zh.brief: cross-scene affordance memory + in-scene spatial memory
insight_zh.route: 冻结 VLM 结合检索定位小操作区域
insight_zh.insight: memory 可补足 VLM 对细小 functional parts 的忽略

methods.insight_en: Augments a frozen VLM with cross-scene affordance memory and in-scene spatial memory retrieval, compensating for VLM neglect of small functional parts.

methods.title: Embodied Spatial Affordance: Spatial-Aware Affordance Learning for Embodied Navigation and Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: EspA，面向 embodied navigation/manipulation 的 spatial-aware affordance reasoning
insight_zh.route: 层级 vision-language architecture 联合推理 object affordance 与 free-space affordance，从语言指令和 2D observation 预测 affordance keypoints，并结合 depth 投影到 3D actionable coordinates
insight_zh.insight: embodied affordance 不只包含 object functionality，还包含可移动、可放置等空间可行性；object-centric 与 free-space affordance 应在统一空间表征中推理

methods.insight_en: Jointly reasons over object and free-space affordances in a hierarchical vision-language model, lifting 2D keypoints through depth into 3D actionable coordinates.

methods.title: Training Agents With Interactive Reinforcement Learning and Contextual Affordances

insight_zh.brief: 在交互式 RL 中利用 contextual affordances 加速机器人 domestic cleaning 学习
insight_zh.route: 将 affordance 作为避免失败状态/动作的上下文约束，与 human/agent trainer 的 interactive RL 结合
insight_zh.insight: affordance 可作为 RL action selection 的先验约束，而非只作为视觉 mask

methods.insight_en: Integrates contextual affordances into interactive RL to avoid failure states, showing affordances can act as prior constraints on action selection.

methods.title: Learning Affordance Space in Physical World for Vision-based Robotic Object Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 真实物理世界中的 affordance space 学习
insight_zh.route: 从视觉观测学习 object manipulation affordance space，并将预测区域用于机器人操作规划
insight_zh.insight: affordance 可作为从视觉到物理操作的中间空间表示

methods.insight_en: Learns a physical affordance space from visual observations and uses the predicted actionable regions to plan robotic object manipulation.

methods.title: Learning Dexterous Grasping with Object-Centric Visual Affordances

insight_zh.brief: 把人类交互偏好的 object-centric affordance 嵌入 dexterous RL
insight_zh.route: 从 object-centric affordance prior 构造 reward/observation guidance，并训练 dexterous RL policy
insight_zh.insight: affordance prior 能约束高维手部策略搜索

methods.insight_en: Embeds object-centric grasp affordance priors into deep RL rewards and observations, constraining high-dimensional dexterous hand policy search.

methods.title: What Can I Do Here? Learning New Skills by Imagining Visual Affordances

insight_zh.brief: VAL
insight_zh.route: 用 generative visual affordance model 引导 goal-conditioned exploration
insight_zh.insight: “想象可能结果”可以指导新技能快速学习

methods.insight_en: Imagines plausible outcomes with a generative visual affordance model to direct goal-conditioned exploration, accelerating acquisition of new skills.

methods.title: Where2Act: From Pixels to Actions for Articulated 3D Objects

insight_zh.brief: 从 RGB-D/point cloud 预测 articulated object 的 actionability、action proposal、action score
insight_zh.route: 在点云上采样 contact point，分别预测 actionability、action proposal 和 action score，再通过参数化 action primitives 执行
insight_zh.insight: 显式 actionability/contact/action proposal 与 action primitive 解耦，属于典型 hierarchical affordance-to-action pipeline

methods.insight_en: Predicts per-point actionability, action proposals, and success scores on articulated objects, then executes them through parameterized motion primitives.

methods.title: AdaAfford: Learning to Adapt Manipulation Affordance for 3D Articulated Objects via Few-shot Interactions

insight_zh.brief: 通过 few-shot test-time interactions 适配 novel articulated objects
insight_zh.route: 通过少量探索交互收集 outcome，在线更新或适配 manipulation affordance predictor
insight_zh.insight: 静态视觉难以估计隐藏 articulation/动力学，需要少量交互校准

methods.insight_en: Adapts manipulation affordance predictions with few-shot test-time interactions, calibrating hidden articulation and dynamics that static vision cannot reveal.

methods.title: Affordance Learning from Play for Sample-Efficient Policy Learning

insight_zh.brief: 从 play data 学 self-supervised visual affordance 并加速 policy learning
insight_zh.route: 从 human teleoperated play 提取 affordance model，结合 model-based planning 与 RL 训练 VAPO policy
insight_zh.insight: 人类 play 中的接触偏好可显著降低机器人交互样本需求

methods.insight_en: Extracts self-supervised visual affordances from human teleoperated play and couples them with model-based planning and RL, cutting robot interaction samples.

methods.title: Learning Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation from Human Grasp Affordance

insight_zh.brief: 用 human grasp affordance model 生成大规模 demonstration，再训练 dexterous manipulation policy
insight_zh.route: 从 human grasp affordance 生成伪示教/目标接触，再训练 dexterous manipulation policy
insight_zh.insight: 人类 grasp prior 可扩展 dexterous policy 的类别泛化

methods.insight_en: Generates large-scale demonstrations from a human grasp affordance model to train dexterous policies that generalize across object categories.

methods.title: Learning 6-DoF Task-oriented Grasp Detection via Implicit Estimation and Visual Affordance

insight_zh.brief: point cloud 输入，预测 3D affordance heatmap 与 6-DoF task grasp
insight_zh.route: 先估计 task affordance/implicit shape representation，再生成并评分 6-DoF grasp pose
insight_zh.insight: task-oriented grasp 不应只依赖 2D mask，需结合 3D pose candidates

methods.insight_en: Estimates 3D affordance heatmaps with implicit shape representations from point clouds, then generates and scores task-oriented 6-DoF grasp poses.

methods.title: VAT-Mart: Learning Visual Action Trajectory Proposals for Manipulating 3D Articulated Objects

insight_zh.brief: actionability + trajectory proposal
insight_zh.route: 从交互/仿真中学习点和轨迹
insight_zh.insight: 对 articulated object 来说，affordance 应包含 post-contact trajectory

methods.insight_en: Learns per-point actionability with post-contact trajectory proposals via interaction in simulation, extending affordance beyond contact points for articulated objects.

methods.title: Grounding Language with Visual Affordances over Unstructured Data

insight_zh.brief: HULC/visuo-lingual affordance model
insight_zh.route: 从 unstructured offline/reset-free data 学语言条件技能
insight_zh.insight: 少量语言标注 + affordance model 可支持长程真实机器人任务

methods.insight_en: Learns a visuo-lingual affordance model from unstructured reset-free data, enabling long-horizon language-conditioned real-robot tasks with few annotations.

methods.title: DualAfford: Learning Collaborative Visual Affordance for Dual-gripper Object Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 双夹爪协作 affordance
insight_zh.route: 把 bimanual contact/action 拆为协同子任务
insight_zh.insight: 多臂 affordance 不是单臂 affordance 的简单叠加

methods.insight_en: Decomposes dual-gripper manipulation into collaborative sub-tasks that predict paired contact affordances, showing bimanual affordance is not additive over single arms.

methods.title: RLAfford: End-to-End Affordance Learning for Robotic Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: RL 中自监督学习 contact/affordance 表征，并用于多任务 manipulation
insight_zh.route: 在 RL rollout 中用接触成功信号自监督训练 affordance head，并与 policy 端到端联合优化
insight_zh.insight: affordance 可作为策略内部表征从交互中涌现

methods.insight_en: Trains affordance representations end-to-end inside RL using contact success signals, letting affordance emerge as internal policy features from interaction.

methods.title: Visual Affordance Prediction for Guiding Robot Exploration

insight_zh.brief: 用 visual affordance prediction 指导 robot exploration
insight_zh.route: VQ-VAE latent space 中用 Transformer 预测 plausible future states，并作为 goal-sampling distribution 训练 goal-conditioned policy
insight_zh.insight: affordance 不只定位接触点，也能作为探索目标分布提高学习效率

methods.insight_en: Predicts plausible future states with a Transformer over a VQ-VAE latent space and samples them as exploration goals for goal-conditioned policy learning.

methods.title: Affordance-Driven Next-Best-View Planning for Robotic Grasping

insight_zh.brief: ACE-NBV
insight_zh.route: 想象新视角下 grasp affordance，并选择最优观察视角
insight_zh.insight: perception action loop 中 affordance 也可指导主动视角选择

methods.insight_en: Imagines grasp affordances under unobserved viewpoints and selects the next-best view accordingly, folding active perception into the affordance-to-grasp loop.

methods.title: DefoAfford: Learning Foresightful Dense Visual Affordance for Deformable Object Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: dense foresightful affordance 估计多步价值，服务 deformable object manipulation
insight_zh.route: 学习 dense visual affordance value map 预测多步 deformable outcome，再指导 pick/place actions
insight_zh.insight: deformable affordance 要考虑长期状态演化，而非单步 contact

methods.insight_en: Learns dense foresightful affordance value maps that predict multi-step deformation outcomes, guiding pick-and-place actions for deformable object manipulation.

methods.title: Learning Environment-aware Affordance for 3D Articulated Object Manipulation under Occlusions

insight_zh.brief: 在 occlusion、robot morphology、environment constraint 下预测 affordance
insight_zh.route: 融合 occluded point cloud、environment geometry 和 robot morphology，预测可行动区域/方向
insight_zh.insight: 可操作性由 object geometry 与环境/机器人共同决定

methods.insight_en: Fuses occluded point clouds, environment geometry, and robot morphology to predict feasible action regions, showing manipulability depends on scene and embodiment.

methods.title: Language Embedded Radiance Fields for Zero-Shot Task-Oriented Grasping

insight_zh.brief: LERF-TOGO，用 3D language field 支持 zero-shot task-oriented grasping
insight_zh.route: 重建 LERF 将 CLIP embedding 蒸馏到多尺度 3D field，再用 DINO object mask 约束 text query，得到 object part semantic distribution，并用现成 grasp planner 对 grasp candidates 排序
insight_zh.insight: open-vocabulary 3D semantic field 可作为 task-oriented grasping 的中间 affordance 表示，将语言部件查询转成抓取选择

methods.insight_en: Distills CLIP embeddings into a 3D language field and queries object parts with DINO-masked text, ranking grasp candidates for zero-shot task-oriented grasping.

methods.title: VoxPoser: Composable 3D Value Maps for Robotic Manipulation with Language Models

insight_zh.brief: LLM/VLM 生成 composable 3D value maps 来指导 zero-shot manipulation
insight_zh.route: LLM 根据语言任务编写 value/constraint map 组合逻辑，调用 VLM grounding 到 3D observation，再由 model-based planner 生成 6-DoF end-effector trajectories
insight_zh.insight: affordance 和 constraints 可被表示为可组合的 3D value maps，连接语言推理与连续轨迹优化

methods.insight_en: Uses LLM-written code with VLM grounding to compose 3D value maps of affordances and constraints, which a model-based planner turns into 6-DoF trajectories.

methods.title: Affordances from Human Videos as a Versatile Representation for Robotics

insight_zh.brief: VRB
insight_zh.route: 从人类视频学习 contact points 与 post-contact trajectories，并接入 IL、exploration、RL action parameterization
insight_zh.insight: human video affordance 是跨机器人学习范式的通用中间表示

methods.insight_en: Learns contact points and post-contact trajectories from human videos, serving as a versatile affordance interface for imitation, exploration, and RL.

methods.title: Open-Vocabulary Part-Based Grasping

insight_zh.brief: 开放词汇 part-conditioned grasping 系统 AnyPart
insight_zh.route: 结合 open-vocabulary detection、part segmentation 和 6-DoF grasp pose prediction 生成指定部件抓取
insight_zh.insight: part-level language grounding 是 task-oriented affordance grasping 的工程化近邻

methods.insight_en: Chains open-vocabulary detection, part segmentation, and 6-DoF grasp prediction to grasp language-specified object parts without task-specific training.

methods.title: Information-driven Affordance Discovery for Efficient Robotic Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: IDA 用信息导向交互加速 affordance discovery
insight_zh.route: 用 uncertainty/information gain 选择交互动作，主动发现 object affordance
insight_zh.insight: 数据采集本身可以被 affordance uncertainty 主动驱动

methods.insight_en: Selects interaction actions by information gain to actively discover object affordances, making data collection itself driven by affordance uncertainty.

methods.title: Learning Precise Affordances from Egocentric Videos for Robotic Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 从 egocentric videos 自动抽取精细 affordance masks，再部署 Aff-Grasp
insight_zh.route: 从 egocentric video 自动抽取 hand-object contact masks，训练 precise affordance detector 并接 grasp module
insight_zh.insight: precise mask 比 coarse heatmap 更能提升真实机器人功能抓取

methods.insight_en: Extracts precise hand-object contact masks from egocentric videos to train an affordance detector, showing fine masks outperform coarse heatmaps for functional grasping.

methods.title: Affordance-based Robot Manipulation with Flow Matching

insight_zh.brief: prompt-tuned affordance model + supervised flow matching 轨迹生成
insight_zh.route: 用 affordance prompt 预测 contact/action condition，并通过 supervised flow matching 生成连续轨迹
insight_zh.insight: affordance learning 和 continuous trajectory generation 可在 flow matching 框架下统一

methods.insight_en: Unifies prompt-tuned affordance prediction and continuous trajectory generation in one supervised flow matching framework for manipulation.

methods.title: ReKep: Spatio-Temporal Reasoning of Relational Keypoint Constraints for Robotic Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 用 relational keypoint constraints 表达多阶段机器人操作任务
insight_zh.route: LVM/VLM 从语言指令和 RGB-D observation 自动生成 3D semantic keypoints 与 Python constraint functions，再通过 hierarchical optimization 输出 SE(3) end-effector pose sequence
insight_zh.insight: keypoint-level affordance/constraint representation 可把空间关系、时间阶段和实时重规划统一到可优化的 action interface

methods.insight_en: Generates 3D semantic keypoints and constraint functions from VLMs, then solves hierarchical optimization to produce SE(3) pose sequences for multi-stage tasks.
