methods.title: Robo-ABC: Affordance Generalization Beyond Categories via Semantic Correspondence for Robot Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 构建 affordance memory，并用 foundation feature correspondence 迁移到 novel objects
insight_zh.route: 建立 source affordance memory，利用 diffusion/semantic correspondence 将 contact region 迁移到 novel object
insight_zh.insight: correspondence 比类别标签更适合跨类别 manipulation affordance

methods.insight_en: Builds an affordance memory and transfers contact regions to novel objects via diffusion-based semantic correspondence, generalizing manipulation beyond categories.

methods.title: PreAfford: Universal Affordance-Based Pre-Grasping for Diverse Objects and Environments

insight_zh.brief: 用 point-level affordance 表示指导 pre-grasping，使两指夹爪能处理难抓物体
insight_zh.route: 预测适合推/拨/预抓取的 affordance points，通过 relay training 训练 pre-grasp planner，并在真实场景提升 grasp success
insight_zh.insight: affordance 不只选择最终抓取点，也能规划让物体变得可抓的预操作

methods.insight_en: Predicts point-level affordances for pre-grasp pushing and reorientation, planning preparatory actions via relay training that make hard objects graspable.

methods.title: RAM: Retrieval-Based Affordance Transfer for Generalizable Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 检索式 affordance memory 支持 zero-shot robot manipulation
insight_zh.route: 从 robot demos、HOI data 和 custom data 提取统一 affordance memory，按语言指令检索 2D affordance 并迁移成 3D executable affordance
insight_zh.insight: affordance correspondence/memory 可把 out-of-domain demonstrations 转为可执行机器人操作

methods.insight_en: Retrieves 2D affordances from a unified memory of robot, HOI, and custom data via language, then lifts them to 3D executable affordances for zero-shot manipulation.

methods.title: GLOVER: Generalizable Open-Vocabulary Affordance Reasoning for Task-Oriented Grasping

insight_zh.brief: LLM/VLM 推理 graspable part，AGE planner 生成 grasp
insight_zh.route: LLM/VLM 做 open-vocabulary part reasoning，AGE planner 将 affordance region 转为 grasp pose
insight_zh.insight: open-vocab grasping 的关键是把 human task spec 映射到功能部件

methods.insight_en: Reasons about graspable parts with LLM/VLM open-vocabulary inference and converts affordance regions into grasp poses through an AGE planner.

methods.title: RT-Affordance: Affordances are Versatile Intermediate Representations for Robot Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 高层根据语言提出 affordance plan，低层 policy 条件化执行
insight_zh.route: 先生成 language-conditioned affordance plan，再用低层 robot policy 执行对应 contact/trajectory
insight_zh.insight: affordance plan 比语言/goal image/trajectory sketch 更轻量且可泛化

methods.insight_en: Proposes language-conditioned affordance plans at the high level and conditions a low-level policy on them, offering a lighter interface than goal images or sketches.

methods.title: ManipGPT: Is Affordance Segmentation by Large Vision Models Enough for Articulated Object Manipulation?

insight_zh.brief: LVM affordance segmentation + impedance adaptation policy 操作 articulated objects
insight_zh.route: 用 LVM/LLM 生成 affordance segmentation，再结合 impedance/controller 执行 articulated manipulation
insight_zh.insight: 大视觉模型 segmentation 需要轻量机器人控制适配才能落地

methods.insight_en: Pairs large-vision-model affordance segmentation with an impedance-adaptive controller, showing LVM masks need lightweight control adaptation for articulated objects.

methods.title: AffordDexGrasp: Open-set Language-guided Dexterous Grasp with Generalizable-Instructive Affordance

insight_zh.brief: language-to-affordance flow matching + grasp flow matching
insight_zh.route: 先从语言生成 instructive affordance，再用 grasp flow matching 采样 dexterous grasp
insight_zh.insight: instructive affordance 是自然语言与高维 dexterous grasp 的桥

methods.insight_en: Generates instructive affordance from language via flow matching, then samples dexterous grasps with a grasp flow, bridging open-set instructions and high-DoF hands.

methods.title: GarmentPile: Point-Level Visual Affordance Guided Retrieval and Adaptation for Cluttered Garments Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 对 cluttered garments 学 point-level affordance，并用 adaptation module 先重排再抓取
insight_zh.route: 预测 garment point-level pull/grasp affordance，结合 retrieval/adaptation module 处理遮挡堆叠
insight_zh.insight: deformable clutter 中 affordance 需要考虑互相缠绕的对象关系

methods.insight_en: Learns point-level pull and grasp affordances on garment piles and rearranges entangled items before grasping, modeling inter-object relations in deformable clutter.

methods.title: A0: An Affordance-Aware Hierarchical Model for General Robotic Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 高层预测 contact/post-contact trajectory，低层执行跨平台 manipulation
insight_zh.route: 高层 affordance model 输出 contact/post-contact trajectory，低层 cross-embodiment controller 执行
insight_zh.insight: object-centric contact + motion affordance 可作为 general manipulation 的可解释中间层

methods.insight_en: Predicts contact points and post-contact trajectories, then executes via cross-embodiment low-level controllers, using affordance as an interpretable intermediate layer.

methods.title: DORA: Object Affordance-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 将 affordance map 用作 candidate prior、policy constraint、reward component
insight_zh.route: 把 affordance map 注入 RL 的动作候选、约束和 reward shaping
insight_zh.insight: dexterous RL 中 affordance 既能缩小搜索，也能校准功能接触

methods.insight_en: Injects affordance maps into dexterous RL as action priors, constraints, and reward shaping, narrowing search while calibrating functional contact.

methods.title: GLOVER++: Unleashing the Potential of Affordance Learning from Human Behaviors for Robotic Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 从 human behavior data 学 affordance transfer，并构建 HOVA-500K
insight_zh.route: 从 human behavior/video 中自动挖掘 affordance supervision，训练可迁移 manipulation grounding
insight_zh.insight: 大规模人类行为能显著扩大 robotic affordance supervision

methods.insight_en: Mines affordance supervision from human behavior videos to build HOVA-500K, showing large-scale human data markedly broadens transferable robotic affordance grounding.

methods.title: AffordDP: Generalizable Diffusion Policy with Transferable Affordance

insight_zh.brief: diffusion policy 显式条件化 3D contact points/post-contact trajectories
insight_zh.route: 把 transferable contact points 和 post-contact trajectory 作为 diffusion policy condition
insight_zh.insight: transferable affordance 可改善 diffusion policy 对 novel objects 的泛化

methods.insight_en: Conditions a diffusion policy on transferable 3D contact points and post-contact trajectories, improving generalization to unseen object instances and categories.

methods.title: BiAssemble: Learning Collaborative Affordance for Bimanual Geometric Assembly

insight_zh.brief: point-level collaborative affordance 支持 bimanual geometric assembly
insight_zh.route: 预测双臂各自的 collaborative affordance points，并规划 assembly sequence/actions
insight_zh.insight: 装配任务中的 affordance 同时包含抓取点、支撑点和协作时序

methods.insight_en: Predicts point-level collaborative affordances for each arm and derives grasp, support, and sequencing actions for bimanual geometric assembly.

methods.title: Towards Affordance-Aware Robotic Dexterous Grasping with Human-like Priors

insight_zh.brief: AffordDex
insight_zh.route: human motion prior + negative affordance-aware segmentation + teacher-student distillation
insight_zh.insight: grasp 不只要稳定，还要避开功能上不该碰的区域

methods.insight_en: Combines human motion priors, negative-affordance segmentation, and teacher-student distillation so dexterous grasps avoid functionally forbidden regions.

methods.title: O3Afford: One-Shot 3D Object-to-Object Affordance Grounding for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 单样本 object-to-object affordance grounding，用于 generalizable robotic manipulation
insight_zh.route: 从单个 object-object 示例学习 relation affordance，再用 correspondence/LLM task constraints 迁移到可执行操作关系
insight_zh.insight: 机器人操作中的 affordance 常是 object-object relation，而不是单物体区域属性

methods.insight_en: Grounds object-to-object relation affordances from a single example and transfers them via correspondence and LLM-derived task constraints into executable manipulation.

methods.title: DART: A Novel Task-Driven Diffusion-Based Policy with Affordance Learning for Generalizable Manipulation of Articulated Objects

insight_zh.brief: LTL task semantics + affordance interaction point + diffusion policy
insight_zh.route: 将 LTL 任务语义、affordance interaction point 与 diffusion action policy 联合建模
insight_zh.insight: 任务逻辑和 affordance 可共同提升 articulated manipulation 泛化

methods.insight_en: Couples LTL task semantics with affordance interaction points in a diffusion policy, showing logic and affordance jointly improve articulated-object generalization.

methods.title: CoA-VLA: Improving Vision-Language-Action Models via Visual-Textual Chain-of-Affordance

insight_zh.brief: 用 Chain-of-Affordance 增强 VLA policy
insight_zh.route: 显式生成 object/grasp/spatial/movement affordances，并通过 visual-textual co-injection 注入 action policy
insight_zh.insight: VLA 的 action prediction 可受益于显式 affordance reasoning chain

methods.insight_en: Generates object, grasp, spatial, and movement affordances as a chain and co-injects them visually and textually into a VLA policy to improve action prediction.

methods.title: OVAL-Grasp: Open-Vocabulary Affordance Localization for Task Oriented Grasping

insight_zh.brief: LLM 选 part，VLM segment，生成 actionable heatmap 并真实抓取
insight_zh.route: LLM 解析 task part，VLM segment 生成 heatmap，再执行 task-oriented grasp
insight_zh.insight: open-vocabulary part localization 可提升任务导向抓取正确性

methods.insight_en: Uses an LLM to select task-relevant parts and a VLM to segment them into actionable heatmaps, executing open-vocabulary task-oriented grasps on real objects.

methods.title: ScaleADFG: Affordance-based Dexterous Functional Grasping via Scalable Dataset

insight_zh.brief: 自动构建 affordance-based functional dexterous grasp dataset，并训练轻量 grasp generator
insight_zh.route: 自动合成大规模 dexterous functional grasp/affordance 数据，训练 grasp generator
insight_zh.insight: 规模化 affordance synthesis 能解决手/物尺寸不匹配

methods.insight_en: Automatically synthesizes a scalable affordance-based functional dexterous grasp dataset and trains a lightweight grasp generator, resolving hand-object scale mismatch.

methods.title: Affordance Field Intervention: Enabling VLAs to Escape Memory Traps in Robotic Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 3D Spatial Affordance Fields 作为 plug-in 干预 VLA，检测 memory trap 并给 waypoint/trajectory score
insight_zh.route: 构建 3D spatial affordance field，运行时对 VLA waypoint/trajectory 进行评分和干预
insight_zh.insight: 外显 affordance field 可补足 VLA 的空间可行性短板

methods.insight_en: Builds 3D spatial affordance fields as a plug-in that scores and corrects VLA waypoints at runtime, detecting memory traps and restoring spatial feasibility.

methods.title: A3D: Adaptive Affordance Assembly with Dual-Arm Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 学 adaptive support/stabilization affordance，随装配状态反馈更新
insight_zh.route: 双臂通过反馈更新 support/stabilization affordance，并自适应生成 assembly actions
insight_zh.insight: dual-arm assembly 的 affordance 是动态、协作且依赖历史的

methods.insight_en: Updates support and stabilization affordances from assembly feedback to adaptively generate dual-arm actions, treating assembly affordance as dynamic and cooperative.

methods.title: FSAG: Enhancing Human-to-Dexterous-Hand Finger-Specific Affordance Grounding via Diffusion Models

insight_zh.brief: 从人类视频抽取 finger-specific affordance，再 retarget 到不同 dexterous hands
insight_zh.route: 从 human video 学 finger-specific contact affordance，扩散生成/retarget 到 robot hand
insight_zh.insight: finger-level affordance 可实现跨手型 dexterous transfer

methods.insight_en: Extracts finger-specific contact affordances from human videos via diffusion models and retargets them to varied dexterous hands, enabling finger-level transfer.

methods.title: One-Shot 3-D Affordance Learning for Multi-Stage Robotic Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: AffoRo-GS，用 one-shot 2D affordance supervision 学 3DGS affordance field，服务多阶段机器人操作
insight_zh.route: 将 action verbs 与多视角 RGB/3D Gaussian features 对齐，在 3D scene 中定位 task-relevant affordance regions，再接 GPD 生成 6-DoF grasp pose 执行
insight_zh.insight: 稀疏 2D verb-centric affordance 可提升为 view-consistent 3D scene affordance，减少 3D 标注和显式 part query 依赖，适合 long-horizon multi-stage manipulation

methods.insight_en: Lifts one-shot 2D verb-centric affordance labels into a view-consistent 3D Gaussian splatting field, then executes GPD 6-DoF grasps for multi-stage manipulation.

methods.title: Affordance-Guided Enveloping Grasp Demonstration Toward Non-destructive Disassembly of Pinch-Infeasible Mating Parts

insight_zh.brief: 物理仿真生成 affordance templates，引导遥操作示教包络抓取
insight_zh.route: 仿真生成 enveloping grasp affordance template，指导 human demonstration/robot imitation
insight_zh.insight: affordance 可作为 human-in-the-loop demonstration 的可视化约束

methods.insight_en: Generates enveloping-grasp affordance templates in physics simulation to guide teleoperated demonstrations for non-destructive disassembly of pinch-infeasible parts.

methods.title: BiPreManip: Learning Affordance-Based Bimanual Preparatory Manipulation through Anticipatory Collaboration

insight_zh.brief: 先 envision final action，再用一只手做 preparatory affordance manipulation 辅助另一只手
insight_zh.route: 先预测最终操作需求，再规划辅助手的 preparatory affordance action
insight_zh.insight: bimanual affordance 包含 anticipatory collaboration

methods.insight_en: Envisions the final action first, then plans the assisting hand's preparatory affordance manipulation, encoding anticipatory collaboration in bimanual affordance.

methods.title: RAAP: Retrieval-Augmented Affordance Prediction with Cross-Image Action Alignment

insight_zh.brief: 检索增强 contact localization + action direction alignment
insight_zh.route: 检索相似交互图像，进行 cross-image action alignment 后预测 target affordance
insight_zh.insight: 小数据机器人 affordance 可借 retrieval memory 泛化到 unseen objects

methods.insight_en: Retrieves similar interaction images and aligns actions across them to predict contact and direction, letting small-data robots generalize affordance to unseen objects.

methods.title: BridgeACT: Bridging Human Demonstrations to Robot Actions via Unified Tool-Target Affordances

insight_zh.brief: 从 human videos 学 tool-target affordance，分解为 where-to-grasp 和 how-to-move，并真实部署
insight_zh.route: 统一 tool-target affordance 表示，映射 human demonstration 到 robot grasp 和 motion
insight_zh.insight: affordance 可作为跨 embodiment 的 human-to-robot action bridge

methods.insight_en: Unifies tool-target affordances from human videos, decomposing them into where-to-grasp and how-to-move signals that bridge human demonstrations to robot actions.

methods.title: A1: A Fully Transparent Open-Source, Adaptive and Efficient Truncated Vision-Language-Action Model

insight_zh.brief: 面向 open-world robot manipulation 的全开源、透明、低成本 VLA framework
insight_zh.route: 利用 pretrained VLM 的 implicit affordance priors 进行 action generation，并通过 budget-aware adaptive inference、intermediate-layer early termination 与 Inter-Layer Truncated Flow Matching 同时加速 VLM backbone 和 action head
insight_zh.insight: VLA 中的 affordance prior 不一定显式输出为 mask 或 plan，也可以作为隐式动作先验服务实时、高吞吐和可复现的机器人控制

methods.insight_en: Exploits implicit affordance priors in a pretrained VLM for action generation, with truncated flow matching and budget-aware early exit for real-time VLA control.

methods.title: Afford-VLA: Action-Aligned Visual Planning via Internalized Affordance

insight_zh.brief: VLA 在动作预测过程中内部生成 `<AFF>` tokens/affordance masks，作为 visual planning 的辅助中间信号
insight_zh.route: action prediction 与 affordance mask/token prediction 联合建模，但 affordance mask 不作为显式外部条件输入 action head
insight_zh.insight: affordance 可以以内化表征或辅助监督形式组织 VLA 的视觉规划，而不一定作为显式 policy condition

methods.insight_en: Jointly predicts <AFF> tokens and affordance masks alongside actions as internalized signals, organizing VLA visual planning without explicit policy conditioning.

methods.title: AffordVLA: Injecting Affordance Representations into Vision-Language-Action Models via Implicit Feature Alignment

insight_zh.brief: 用 affordance teacher 对齐 VLA 中间视觉表示，不显式输出 mask
insight_zh.route: 用 affordance teacher 对齐 VLA 中间 features，通过隐式损失训练 action policy
insight_zh.insight: 隐式 affordance alignment 能保留 E2E VLA 简洁性并提升 manipulation

methods.insight_en: Aligns intermediate VLA visual features with an affordance teacher through implicit losses, improving manipulation while preserving end-to-end simplicity.

methods.title: PALM: Progress-Aware Policy Learning via Affordance Reasoning for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: 面向长程多步 manipulation 的 progress-aware VLA policy
insight_zh.route: 蒸馏 object relevance、contact geometry、spatial placement、motion dynamics 等交互中心 affordance 表征，并预测 subtask 内连续进度以稳定切换
insight_zh.insight: 长程 VLA 可通过内部 affordance/progress 表征稳定阶段切换，减少重复动作、漏步骤和过早终止

methods.insight_en: Distills interaction-centric affordance features and predicts continuous subtask progress inside a VLA, stabilizing stage transitions in long-horizon manipulation.

methods.title: AGiLe: Learning Robust Long-Horizon Manipulation via Affordance-Grounded Bidirectional Latent Planning

insight_zh.brief: 面向 language-guided long-horizon manipulation 的 robust planning-execution framework
insight_zh.route: 在 latent space 中用 backward planner 生成 goal-directed subgoals，并用 forward critic 验证 reachability；再将 latent subgoal 作为 query，通过 cross-modal affordance grounding 过滤 task-relevant visual features，并条件化 diffusion policy 生成低层动作
insight_zh.insight: bidirectional latent planning 提升时间一致性，affordance grounding 将抽象 subgoal 落到可执行的视觉区域，从而同时缓解 error accumulation 和 planning-execution gap

methods.insight_en: Plans latent subgoals backward with forward-critic reachability checks, grounding each subgoal into task-relevant visual regions that condition a diffusion policy.

methods.title: AffordGen: Generating Diverse Demonstrations for Generalizable Object Manipulation with Affordance Correspondence

insight_zh.brief: 利用 affordance correspondence 生成多样化 demonstration，提升 object manipulation policy 的泛化
insight_zh.route: 从少量 source demonstrations 中提取 affording point 与 function point，并借助 3D mesh semantic correspondence 将 grasp/skill trajectory 迁移到大量 novel objects 和 6D poses，再用生成数据训练 closed-loop visuomotor policy
insight_zh.insight: affordance 不只可用于在线规划，也可作为 demonstration generation prior，将少量示教扩展为跨实例、跨类别且语义一致的训练数据

methods.insight_en: Transfers grasp and skill trajectories to novel objects via 3D mesh affordance correspondence, expanding few demonstrations into diverse data for closed-loop policies.

methods.title: AffordanceVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model Empowering Action Generation through Affordance-Aware Understanding

insight_zh.brief: 通过 affordance-aware understanding 增强 VLA action generation
insight_zh.route: 联合预测 Which2Act、Where2Act、How2Act 三层 affordance-aware signals，并作为内部中间表征辅助动作生成
insight_zh.insight: 把目标物、交互区域和动作方式分层建模为内部 affordance 表征，可提升 VLA 在复杂 manipulation 中的可解释性和泛化

methods.insight_en: Jointly predicts Which2Act, Where2Act, and How2Act signals as internal affordance representations, improving VLA interpretability and generalization in manipulation.

methods.title: Affordance2Action: Task-Conditioned Scene-level Affordance Grounding for Real-Time Manipulation

insight_zh.brief: A2A，学习 task-conditioned scene-level part affordance，并将其用于实时机器人抓取/操作
insight_zh.route: 提出 A2A-Bench 与 A2A-AffordGen 构建 task-conditioned instruction-region supervision；在下游 real-time manipulation 中同时尝试显式 affordance-conditioned policy 和隐式 affordance 表征辅助策略学习
insight_zh.insight: scene-level affordance 不只是 grounding benchmark，也可以通过 explicit condition 或 implicit representation 两种方式为机器人抓取提供空间先验

methods.insight_en: Builds task-conditioned scene-level part affordance supervision with A2A-Bench and uses it as explicit conditions or implicit representations for real-time grasping.

methods.title: GCNGrasp-VP: Affordance-Guided View Planning for Efficient Task-Oriented Grasping

insight_zh.brief: 用 affordance field 指导 active view planning，提升 occlusion 下的 task-oriented grasping
insight_zh.route: GCNGrasp-v2 同时进行 grasp evaluation 与 affordance field prediction，Affordance-VP 将 affordance field 作为 information gain metric，选择下一视角观察 task-relevant regions，无需完整 scene reconstruction
insight_zh.insight: task-oriented grasping 中，affordance 不只决定抓哪里，也能决定先看哪里；主动视角选择可把任务语义和遮挡处理纳入 grasp pipeline

methods.insight_en: Uses a jointly predicted affordance field as the information-gain metric for next-best-view planning, showing affordances guide where to look as well as where to grasp.
